programme.title: Their Finest
programme.desc: Wartime comedy drama based on Lissa Evans's novel Their Finest Hour and a Half, starring Gemma Arterton, Bill Nighy and Sam Claflin. Catrin Cole travels from Wales into the thick of the London Blitz to work as a typist on propaganda films made by the Ministry of Information. And with the productions desperately needing a female perspective, Catrin seems the perfect person for the job.

programme.title: Iran: The People's Story
programme.desc: In-depth current affairs report covering a story behind the headlines

programme.title: Sisters in Country: Dolly, Linda and Emmylou
programme.desc: How Dolly Parton, Linda Ronstadt and Emmylou Harris's careers took off in the 1970s with very distinct takes on country music, before they came together to collaborate on a successful album in 1987. The artists talk about uniting as harmony singers, focusing on how their alliance made them pioneers in bringing different music worlds together and raising the game for women in the country tradition. Narrated by KT Tunstall

programme.title: Aberfan: The Village That Fought Back
programme.desc: The catastrophic collapse in 1966 of a coal-waste tip above the south Wales village of Aberfan remains one of the most devastating tragedies in modern British history. The slide engulfed a school and neighbouring homes, claiming the lives of 116 children and 28 adults in a disaster that shocked the world, but the story of what followed has been largely forgotten. Marking the 60th anniversary, this documentary uncovers the little-told story of the extraordinary campaign that emerged in the disaster's aftermath, revealing how a shattered village rose from unimaginable grief to demand justice, challenged the most powerful institutions in Britain, and forced the removal of the coal tips that still loomed above their homes

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When a jukebox washes up, its catchy song proves a hit among the Piripenguins, driving Pancake up the wall. A solution is needed, but how can he stop a seemingly unstoppable trend?

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: During a hoverboard race, Dad's new super-powered hoverboard malfunctions, so Cosima and Big Lizard throw the race to rescue him!

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: It's mini mayhem when the Ducklings find a device that can shrink things

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Blossom is terrible at keeping secrets, and Trevor can't help but point that out. To prove him wrong, Blossom refuses to reveal the secret hiding place for her piece of the Amulet of Protection, even though the heroes need it to stop Balthazar casting a weather spell on the forest. With a rain of crabs heading their way, the heroes must quickly persuade Blossom to reveal her secret.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings catch a grasshopper that can give you whatever your heart desires.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck and Frog are DJ's at a wedding, and Frog decides to liven things up with some banging tunes, much to the horror of Duck, the wedding planner and an angry father of the bride!

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons: Rising Hope
programme.desc: Lacey challenges Ult with a special kind of training in the Terarium

programme.desc: While in Alfea, fairies and witches prepare for the self-defence test in the simulation chamber, and Bloom is paired with her rival Jasper. Tensions rise when Jasper makes a pact with the Trix.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: Kenzie adjusts to the new assistant coach, Denise. Ruby worries about the growing tensions between Levi and Ashton, and Layla feels pressure from Denise to perform.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Current affairs reports aimed at a younger audience

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: The team celebrates Diwali with Shini and Hacker demonstrating how to make decorations for it

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to the cities of Chile in search of the wildlife surviving alongside people. From feisty sea lions to a giant bullfrog that needs protecting for its survival.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don presents his last programme from Longmeadow after 16 years, celebrating gardening's pleasures and making a final bulb lasagne. Autumn brings sowing, planting and apple gathering, while Carol Klein explores plant shoots, and Joe Swift visits Ann-Marie Powell's garden. Cameras also focus on a North Yorkshire tree grower, and a couple nurturing a garden

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham is joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin for an exploration of Britain's wildlife, tackling the fascinating, the unexpected and the downright bizarre. Throughout the run, the team investigates some of nature's biggest mysteries, including where the acorns have all gone, why a group of crows is known as a murder and how small is Britain's smallest bird

programme.title: Grand Hotel
programme.desc: Oscar-winning drama starring Greta Garbo, John Barrymore and Joan Crawford. The guests at a luxurious Berlin hotel include a famous but unhappy ballerina, a hard-up baron who has turned thief, a dying clerk, a ruthless businessman and an ambitious secretary. Their contrasting stories unfold during their stay at the hotel.

programme.title: Ice Station Zebra
programme.desc: Alistair MacLean's Arctic adventure, starring Rock Hudson, Ernest Borgnine and Patrick McGoohan. When a secret film capsule from a Russian spacecraft lands near Station Zebra, the tiny weather base is plunged into the shadowy world of the Cold War and a potentially cataclysmic confrontation between two deadly superpowers.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Five experts assess items brought to the Blickling estate in Norfolk, with David Harper excited by an early device for watching films, and David Fletcher and James Lewis reminisce about Rupert the Bear books and Dinky toys. Paul Martin enjoys a ride in a tank on historic former military camp

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Sam Ryder, Jeff Stelling and Ella Eyre, accompanied by friends or relatives, and Princess and Junior Andre continue their epic 7,500km race. The second leg takes the teams across the heart of Borneo to a modern metropolis on its eastern coast and their second checkpoint

programme.title: Match of the Day Live: The FA Cup
programme.desc: Altrincham v Notts County (Kick-off 5.30pm). All the action from the first-round tie at J Davidson Stadium. National League outfit Altrincham reached this stage with an emphatic 6-2 win away to local rivals FC United of Manchester. They are now looking for an upset against the Magpies, who are now in League One, having also been playing non-league football as recently as the 2022/23 campaign

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: The crew at Tower, on the River Thames in London, is the busiest of all the lifeboat stations, averaging more than 500 shouts a year and aiming to launch to any emergency in under 90 seconds. When a call comes in about a man in the water near the Thames Barrier, they reach him with just moments to spare. In Fleetwood, on the Lancashire coast, a desperate 999 call alerts the crew to a bait digger - out looking for worms on the sand flats - who has been caught out by the incoming spring tide and is in danger of being submerged and swept out to sea

programme.title: 40 TV Theme Tunes at the BBC
programme.desc: Archive performances of songs from popular TV shows that made the charts, sometimes performed by members of the cast and sometimes featuring recognisable tracks from the big names of the day. Including the theme tunes from Friends, The Office, Derry Girls, Absolutely Fabulous, Twin Peaks, Peaky Blinders, The Sopranos, Happy Valley, Mash, Hill Street Blues, Doctor Who and even Top of the Pops

programme.title: Greatest BBC Music Moments
programme.desc: To celebrate 90 years of BBC Television, this is a deep dive into the vaults to find the unforgettable headliners, the raw talent, the historic nights and the songs that defined generations. Jo Whiley, Jack Saunders, Vernon Kay, Dermot O'Leary, DJ Target, DJ Spoony, Jamz Supernova, Nick Grimshaw and Katie Derham pick memorable archive performances including Pulp at the BBC Radio Theatre and Stormzy on Glastonbury's Pyramid Stage

programme.title: The Taste of Things
programme.desc: Period romantic drama starring Benoît Magimel and Juliette Binoche. On a beautiful estate in late 19th-century France, renowned gourmet Dodin works alongside his lover, the talented cook Eugénie. But despite the harmony of their unconventional relationship, all he really wants is her hand in marriage.

programme.desc: Children's food educator Beth Stephens hosts the first dinner party in Lowestoft, Suffolk, where she plans to impress her guests - caravan site owner Ray, beauty therapist Polly, housing officer Jonalt and ASBO officer Rachel - with locally sourced seasonal food. programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The final dinner party in Suffolk is hosted by anti-social behaviour officer Rachel, who hopes to win over her guests with an evening of comfort food and a few tricks up her sleeve. programme.title: Devon and Cornwall
programme.desc: Compilation of highlights from previous series. High up on Dartmoor, shepherds Steve and Crispin Alford ride their horses out to gather their sheep for a speed shearing competition. programme.title: Grand Designs
programme.desc: Gallery owner Elinor and fitness entrepreneur Born set themselves the task of creating Britain's first hypoallergenic house in a leafy back garden plot in south-west London. Driven by the need to alleviate their two young sons' life-threatening allergies, their new part-submerged, shed-inspired home, will be constructed using low toxin materials and deploy cutting-edge filtration systems to clean the air they breathe. Will their innovative new house deliver the benefits Elinor and Born are hoping for?

programme.desc: Ray runs into trouble while trying to show Debra he can take over the running of the family finances, and resorts to a series of elaborate lies to get himself out of the mess he has created. Comedy, starring Ray Romano and Patricia Heaton

programme.desc: Ray gets bored when he goes for a ride in Robert's police car, but his disinterest is soon replaced by terror when they get caught in a hold-up

programme.desc: Sideshow Bob escapes from jail on a mission to destroy television for good, and holds Springfield to ransom with a stolen nuclear warhead. Featuring the guest voices of Kelsey Grammer and R Lee Ermey

programme.desc: The family visits a theme park based on Bart and Lisa's favourite TV cartoon The Itchy & Scratchy Show - but Homer is arrested, the kids are mischievous and the mechanised attractions go berserk

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer step into the middle of a domestic deadlock in Wolverhampton. programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: Animated fantasy with the voices of Catherine O'Hara, Martin Short and Charlie Tahan. Unable to accept the death of his pet pooch, young science whizz Victor performs an experiment that brings him back to life. But his secret is soon discovered and it's not long before havoc is wreaked all over town.

programme.title: Percy Jackson & the Lightning Thief
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan and Sean Bean. A school trip to a museum takes an unexpected turn for teenager Percy Jackson when he is revealed to be the son of Greek god Poseidon. He is immediately plunged into a quest to retrieve a lightning bolt belonging to Zeus and prevent a divine war.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: Animated science-fiction adventure based on Robert Louis Stevenson's classic novel, Treasure Island. When a pirate treasure map falls into the hands of young tearaway Jim Hawkins, he is determined to find the fabled loot. Joining a space galleon as a cabin boy, he sets off on an intergalactic voyage of discovery, under the watchful eye of mysterious cyborg cook John Silver.

programme.title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
programme.desc: Action adventure sequel starring Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger, Jon Voight and Helen Mirren. When a stranger informs them that one of their ancestors might have been involved in the plot to assassinate President Lincoln, treasure hunter Ben Gates and his archaeologist father Patrick set out to clear the family name. Their quest takes them to Buckingham Palace and the White House, where they uncover evidence of a lost city of gold.

programme.title: Captain America: Civil War
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Chris Evans and Robert Downey Jr. When world leaders decide a law is needed to regulate superheroes and hold them accountable for their actions, a rift is created between Captain America and Iron Man that forces the rest of the Avengers to pick sides.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: Drama starring Chris Evans. Frank has raised his niece Mary, a maths prodigy, to be as "normal" as possible. Then Mary's snobbish grandmother suddenly arrives, sparking a difficult custody battle.

programme.title: Expedition X
programme.desc: Phil and Jess venture into the Great Smoky Mountains to investigate missing hiker reports and sightings of grotesque human-like creatures.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Two pairs of survivalists must take on the deadly jungles of Panama side-by-side. But before their 21-day challenge begins, they have a big decision to make.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: Three weeks of long hours and horrendous conditions cause tempers to fray and the men begin to turn on one another. Elsewhere, ice stands between a skipper and the safety of the harbour

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: The crews fish for crabs off the coast of Alaska, battling freezing spray, mountainous waves and sub-zero temperatures. As they try to make their way back to St Paul's Harbour, they discover it is frozen shut by Arctic pack ice

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: Midway through the season, the crews begin to find their work hampered by the intense cold, as the crabs, equipment and harbour all freeze. Meanwhile, the Northwestern battles a raging storm

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: The crews hear rumours of prime fishing near the ice pack, and a race begins to see who can reach the area first, but the long hours and adverse conditions gradually begin to take their toll on the men

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: In South Australia, fearless rookie opal miners leave their lives behind, risking all on their mission to unearth a fortune in some of the country's harshest and remotest landscapes.

programme.title: Opal Hunters: Red Dirt Road Trip
programme.desc: Record-breaking floods block Rod and JC on the first leg of their road trip. Plus, JC is taught how to make explosives and mine with them by local legends, the Bomb Kings.

programme.title: Opal Hunters: Red Dirt Road Trip
programme.desc: Rod and JC battle extreme weather and steep terrain as they search for sapphires. Then, the duo undertakes a huge fishing expedition: hunting the mythical Tassie Tiger.

programme.title: The Snake Catcher
programme.desc: When a venomous snake is found hiding in a kindergarten, Julia has to act quickly so that no child is harmed. Plus, a customer has spotted an eastern brown snake on his property, the second most venomous snake in the world.

programme.title: The Snake Catcher
programme.desc: Julia and her snake catcher colleague David head to Airlie Beach to catch two venomous snakes. And, an eastern brown snake, the second most dangerous land snake in the world, has crawled into a garage and needs to be caught as quickly as possible.

programme.title: The Snake Catcher
programme.desc: Julia and her snake catcher colleague, Stuart McKenzie, deal with a large python hanging in a treetop. Then, a mother discovers a snake while playing hide and seek with her children. Plus, Julia has acquired a tarantula as a new pet to overcome her fears.

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: The Dirt Dogs and Gold Gypsies fight back against the rising number of gold thieves. Meanwhile, the Scrappers' washplant conveyor belt comes to a screaming halt.

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: The Mahoneys spend thousands of dollars on a loader for a final push at 8-Mile, and Alex is convinced there's big gold at Relief Creek. The Gold Gypsies strike it lucky.

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: With the season close to ending, the Dirt Dogs struggle to hunt out their final $350,000 of gold. The Mahoneys bring in machinery in a final effort to hit their target.

programme.title: Hoarding: Buried Alive
programme.desc: Traci wants to move back into her childhood home. But it's filled with her mother Jerri's stuff. Can they work together to clear a decade worth of clutter?

programme.title: Hoarding: Buried Alive
programme.desc: Kathleen discovers mice living in her kitchen. And for Jaime's future son-in-law, spending the night in a hoard might end a marriage before it even begins.

programme.title: Extinct or Alive
programme.desc: In Indonesia, Forrest seeks the Millers Grizzled Langur, or Dracula monkey. When he hears of an illegal pet market, his search becomes a rescue mission.

programme.title: Tales from the Explorers Club
programme.desc: Josh Gates recounts club members' death-defying exploits to the top and bottom of the world. Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay summit Mount Everest, two submariners plunge seven miles under the Pacific and a pilot skydives from the edge of space.

programme.title: Dating Naked
programme.desc: Chris and Kerri try to put their feelings for each other aside, believing they have each found someone else better suited to them - but four new arrivals complicate things further

programme.title: Naked Attraction

programme.title: Gogglebox

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: Marina resolves to be less guarded in her love life, then regrets it. Tzarina and Lara are at loggerheads but with no one willing to apologise, they appear to be at a dead end

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads for Bridgeport, Connecticut, to visit Cafe Tavolini, which is being neglected by husband and wife managers teetering on the edge of divorce. The estranged couple's two children are struggling to save the business from their parents' disputes, and the visiting chef tries to shock the pair into stopping the restaurant from becoming a casualty of their quarrel

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to the Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets a stubborn owner who doesn't react well to criticism. Tom bought the restaurant for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he's still refusing to let her run it. Can the chef break Tom's iron grip on the business and persuade him to change his outdated approach?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Troy McClure hosts three spin-off segments, transplanting characters from the show into new situations and locations, including Chief Wiggum's attempt to make his name as a private investigator, ably assisted by streetwise sidekick Principal Skinner, alias 'Skinny Boy'

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil and Claire aren't too happy when Haley starts spending a lot of time with Andy. Gloria announces she wants Manny to learn Spanish, so hires a dashing teacher for him, and Cameron and Mitchell make the headlines after meeting a news reporter at a school function

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Emmy-winning comedy returns - as do Cameron and Mitchell, who are back from honeymoon and determined to keep the romance alive. Cameron, however, takes it just a little step too far. The Dunphys, meanwhile, have been enjoying a relaxing summer without smart-alec Alex, who is away on a trip - although she threatens to rock the boat after arriving home early - and Gloria shows a different side after arguing with Jay about the lack of effort he puts into his appearance

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay and Gloria celebrate their anniversary, but cannot decide on what kind of gift to give each other. Meanwhile, the Dunphys join Alex on her college tour and Phil, Luke and Haley find themselves in a mirrored waiting room with a button and a sign that says 'Do Not Push'. Comedy, starring Ed O'Neill and Julie Bowen

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil comes across footage of an incriminating sneeze while looking at Cameron and Mitchell's wedding video that proves he is responsible for the family's flu epidemic, so he sets about getting rid of the proof with the help of Luke and some creative editing. Claire struggles to make it through an important business meeting while feeling under the weather, while Cam is forced to make a difficult decision when it comes to Manny and the school football team. Mitch meets Lily's know-it-all friend and male nanny Andy (Andy DeVine) makes a welcome return

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Essex groom Gary plans an aquatic wedding 200 miles from home. But Lauren hopes for a home counties service. Will Gary's underwater dream sink without a trace?

programme.title: Made in Chelsea
programme.desc: Chuggs is shaken by Rosie's arrival, but can she win him back? Jack and Jazz come to blows over Inga. Liam tags along on Angus's date. And when Sam Prince disappears, Arman sees an opportunity to make his move on Maali

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In this revisit episode, chef Gordon Ramsay goes back to Mojito, the Junction (formerly known as Flamangos) and Bazzini to check in with the owners he helped in the past and find out whether his advice has been put to good use. Will he be pleased with their progress?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef travels to Los Angeles to help La Frite, an outdated French restaurant that is failing to make any profits. His first step is to try to reconcile the feuding family members who run the business, and so devises a plan to bring them together by using secret filming

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay revisits three of the restaurants he tried to save, returning to Lido, Anna Vincenzo's and Le Bistro to find out whether his advice has been put to good use

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Strong men are left quaking by the news that alcohol has been made illegal in Springfield. Luckily salvation is at hand in the form of prohibition-busting bootlegger Homer, who brews his own beer to meet demand. Featuring the guest voice of Joe Mantegna

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart is shocked to discover Principal Skinner in a passionate clinch with Mrs Krabappel at a birthday party and finds himself being used as a highly reluctant go-between in their illicit relationship

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart has the bright idea of taking out a credit card in Santa's Little Helper's name and orders a fully trained pedigree collie. Unfortunately, he has trouble keeping up the payments and soon receives a visit from bailiffs wanting to repossess all his purchases

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa takes pity on a bankrupt Mr Burns and encourages him to build a recycling centre, hoping it will get him back on his feet - but makes the mistake of underestimating his ruthlessness. Featuring the guest voice of wrestler Bret Hart

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge begins work as a church volunteer and restores Reverend Lovejoy's faith in his vocation, while Homer is baffled to discover his image printed on a box of Japanese washing powder

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart and Lisa are thrilled when their parents send them to Kamp Krusty for the summer - but when they arrive, they discover that having fun will not be high on the agenda. Animated antics, with the voices of Dan Castellaneta, Nancy Cartwright and Yeardley Smith

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge astonishes Homer and the kids by landing the role of Blanche DuBois in an amateur production of A Streetcar Named Desire - and her performance is boosted by her frustration with Homer. With the guest voice of Jon Lovitz

programme.title: Christmas with the Kranks
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis. After their daughter goes to Peru to serve with the Peace Corps, Luther and Nora Krank face their first Christmas alone. Miserable at the prospect, they decide to completely forget yuletide and go on a Caribbean cruise. But their change of plan doesn't go smoothly.

programme.title: Jingle All the Way
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. Young Jamie Langston wants a "Turbo Man" toy for Christmas, but his father Howard is too wrapped up in work to remember his son's request. Until Christmas Eve, that is, when Howard's furious wife sends him on a desperate quest to bring home the last Turbo Man in Minneapolis - whatever it takes.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Bake Off
programme.desc: Noel Fielding and Alison Hammond host as soap stars past and present Chris Bisson, Natalie Cassidy, Dean Gaffney, Shobna Gulati and Sheree Murphy put their own spin on a traditional yule log, test their meringue skills and create their favourite storyline in biscuit form. programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Western directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L Jackson and Christoph Waltz. After being freed from slavery and trained in the ways of a bounty hunter by Dr King Schultz, Django sets out to free his wife from a vicious plantation owner.

programme.title: Bone Tomahawk
programme.desc: After an outlaw unknowingly leads a band of cannibalistic cave-dwellers into the peaceful town of Bright Hope, the elderly sheriff rounds up a posse to rescue townsfolk abducted by the ferocious tribesmen. Western horror, starring Kurt Russell and Patrick Wilson

programme.title: Earth vs the Flying Saucers
programme.desc: Science-fiction fantasy starring Hugh Marlowe. After aliens abduct his father-in-law, a research scientist tries to prevent an invasion of the Earth.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: TV-movie version of the classic Charles Dickens tale, starring George C Scott and Nigel Davenport. Ebenezer Scrooge has no time for Christmas and is impervious to the suffering around him. But his attitude is put to the test one Christmas Eve when he is visited by three ghostly spirits.

programme.title: Miracle on 34th Street
programme.desc: Christmas fantasy starring Richard Attenborough and Elizabeth Perkins. Going against the wishes of her divorced mother, a sceptical young girl asks a mysterious department-store Santa Claus for the family she has always wanted.

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: Romantic comedy, based on Shakespeare's The Taming of the Shrew, starring Heath Ledger and Julia Stiles. Bianca Stratford is banned by her parents from going on a date until her older sister Katarina has a boyfriend, but unfortunately big sister has an excessively aggressive personality and only manages to send most boys running for cover. However, when a new guy arrives in town, Bianca's suitor Joey hits on a plan that could be the answer to their problem.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring James Franco and Freida Pinto. When scientist Will Rodman's programme of drug experiments to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease is shut down he secretly takes an offspring from one of the chimpanzees he was using into his home and names him Caesar. Caesar has inherited the effects of the trial drug and begins to show remarkable intelligence, a development that will put him on a violent collision course with the humans who have abused him.

programme.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
programme.desc: Struggling to cope with his alter ego Venom, Eddie Brock attempts to re-ignite his journalistic career by interviewing serial killer Cletus Kasady. However, Kasady becomes the host of the symbiote Carnage and escapes prison after a failed execution. Comic-book fantasy sequel, directed by Andy Serkis and starring Tom Hardy, Woody Harrelson and Michelle Williams

programme.title: The Creator
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring John David Washington. Huge leaps in robotics and machine learning lead to an artificial intelligence apparently choosing to detonate a nuclear bomb over Los Angeles. Now outlawed across much of the world, all remaining AI-powered bots have relocated to New Asia where US soldier Joshua Taylor is sent to find information about a formidable weapon being developed by the machines.

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Ben and Ambika kick off the competition in Hertfordshire with a south-east Asian menu. Their guests are Sinead from Northern Ireland and her prank-loving partner Tony, and competitive couple Kally and Mark. The lads bond over football, and by the end of the night Tony has played a prank or two setting the tone for the week. Subsequently, Kally and Mark put on an Anglo-Indian menu, but things soon get heated in the kitchen. Then, Tony and Sinead serve up an Irish menu, with silly dances, silly jokes and silly accents. However, it remains to be seen which couple will pocket the prize for best soiree

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In north Devon, married couple Frankie and Jason kick off the competition. Outspoken duo Kate and Ian don't let the evening's many delays go unnoticed, and as tensions rise around the table, internet lovebirds Chris and Amy try to stay firmly out of the way. Day two sees Kate and Ian serve up a menu full of rustic French cuisine, influenced by their 22 years living in France. But a table laying mishap suggests that Kate has overtly snubbed her guests, although tensions are eased when former falconers Kate and Ian bring out one of their favourite birds of prey. Finally it's dog lovers Chris and Amy's turn to step up to the plate, and believing themselves to be the foodies of the group they're confident they can bag the prize for best soiree

programme.title: Property Brothers: Buying and Selling
programme.desc: In the fifth season, more couples put their homes in the bros' hands. Can Jonathan and Drew raise the roof off of dilapidated, draughty and dingy digs? Frustrated with only one low offer and not enough space, Samantha and Justin turn to the twins to transform their compartmentalised house. But a nasty surprise awaits them. programme.desc: Self-conscious Richard choo-choo-chooses a first-class trip for bride Latrice on their wedding day. Will his plans live up to her grand expectations?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Romantic groom Ash wants to pull off the Most Romantic Wedding ever, but his bride-to-be Vicki shuns anything corny. Ash has really got his work cut out to win her around.

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Leon wants to get wed on a beach in Weymouth. But bride-to-be Kirsty wants a fairy-tale day somewhere special to her. Will they sail into the sunset or is Leon out of his depth?

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Walk-On's is a sports bar chain with plans to double in size, but whether its 4,000 employees are ready to make this audacious move is unclear. Founder Brandon Landry and co-owner, NFL champion New Orleans Saints quarterback Drew Brees hope to find out by hiding in plain sight, joining staff on the front line in their restaurants. They meet a kitchen porter, an assistant manager and a dock supervisor for their main shrimp supplier, in a bid to get to the heart of their business. In the end, Brandon and Drew reveal their true identities and help make their employees' dreams a reality.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Clean Harbours is a hazardous waste disposal company, dealing with everything from hurricanes and oil spills to the 9/11 clean-up operation. Its chairman and founder Alan McKim is struggling to avoid losing highly trained employees as the business expands, so he goes undercover as a mechanic to discover the reason why

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to the Park's Edge restaurant in Atlanta, Georgia, where a series of spats with the local community are hampering its success. Owners Richard and Jorge's in-fighting has alienated locals, and the duo's suggestion that customer numbers are low because of racism has heightened tensions

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to the Greek at the Harbour restaurant in southern California, where owner Makis Mikelatos works 17 hours a day, seven days a week, but is unwilling to let his son Ari take the reins. Gordon sets out to get to the bottom of Makis's reluctance to teach his son, and uncovers a shocking family secret

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to Mike & Nellie's Steakhouse in Oakhurst, New Jersey, where owner Mike Farber is mourning his father Nellie, who was also his business partner. Having been called in by the restaurateur's two daughters, Gordon faces the task of getting him to focus on his business, before tackling the bigger problem of rotting decor and a less-than-appealing menu

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay travels to the El Greco restaurant in Austin, Texas, where the owners have resorted to using a microwave to prepare their 'authentic' Greek dishes. Gordon faces the difficult task of uniting a squabbling family before tackling the bigger problem of a business on the brink of collapse

programme.desc: Ceramics restorer Kirsten Ramsay's skills are pushed to their limit as she works on a four-foot stone birdbath which has a huge crack, threatening to break it in two. Finally, Julie Tatchell and Amanda Middleditch gives some much-needed TLC to a well-travelled teddy bear from the 1950s

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team breathe new life into three cherished family heirlooms, resurrecting precious memories.
First though the barn doors is Diana Cook, with a German-English dictionary for the attention of bookbinder Chris Shaw. The fragile pocket-sized book belonged to her mother Margot and helped her to learn English when she first arrived in the UK as a Jewish refugee. Margot escaped Nazi Germany at just 19 years of age, just before the Second World War, and was able to finish her nursing training in the UK thanks in part to the dictionary, which was always stowed in her apron pocket. For Diana, the book represents her mother's bravery and determination, so she'd like it preserved to pass on to her grandchildren and continue the legacy of Margot's life. With its broken spine, fractured boards and loose pages, it's a painstaking but important fix for Chris.
Motorbike enthusiasts Dom Chinea and Suzie Fletcher are eager to start work on a 1950s motorbike helmet and goggles delivered by Andy Cattani. They belonged to his daredevil uncle Peter, who used them to race at death-defying speeds. Andy spent a lot of time with his uncle as a lad, tinkering on old cars and motorbikes, learning skills that he went on to use to set up his own mechanics business. Andy has big plans to display the helmet and goggles in his home in tribute to his uncle, but the rubber surrounding the eyepieces on the goggles has disintegrated over the years, and the leather lining in the helmet is very tired and dry. Fortunately, Dom and Suzie devise an ingenious plan to bring the items back to life.
The final treasure is a job for wood restorer Will Kirk. The hobby horse was Michelle Turner's pride and joy. It was made especially for her by her grandfather to celebrate the Queen's silver jubilee. She and her grandfather, who was known as Pop Pop, were as thick as thieves and were forever up to mischief! Michelle was the envy of the street, with her own steed to dash about on. She's now a teacher and would like to share the hobby horse with her pupils, but its glory days are now in the past. It is riddled with woodworm and bits are falling off, so it's a tough task for Will to bring the horse back to full health.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life. They restore a leather satchel, a pair of vintage scissors and an elderly teddy bear.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Helen Giltrow presents a miniature silver kettle, hoping that silversmith Brenton West can get it singing again. A cherished violin and a 1950s toy rocket that's lost its spark are also restored. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team resuscitate three family heirlooms, reviving the memories that they hold.
The barn's first arrival is Clint Yallop. He has brought in his grandfather's notebook, which desperately requires the skills of bookbinder Chris Shaw. Clint's grandfather, George Yallop, worked as a pathology technician at the Royal London Hospital in the early 1900s and meticulously documented his research and experiments in notebooks like this. Sadly, this is the only one that remains, which makes it even more precious to Clint. He remembers his grandfather as an intriguing gentleman who was always warm and welcoming. Clint would like to refer to the scientific notebook during his own studies in horticulture, but the fragile book is crumbling. Chris is fascinated by the little notebook and throws himself into this unusual restoration project.
Next to arrive at the barn is Matt Goddard, who is hoping an unfinished labour of love can be completed by wood wizard Will Kirk. Matt's father passed away before he could finish this model of a merchant trading ship, and although Matt has good intentions, he knows the complicated construction is beyond him. The abandoned nautical build has been gathering dust for decades, and Matt and his siblings feel it's the right time to finish what his father started and share it, passing it one to another every Christmas so they can all be reminded of his passion for all things nautical. Will concentrates on the intricate wooden structure and ropes in Amanda to help with the sails.
Goldsmith Richard Talman greets the day's last visitor to the barn, Sarah Kershaw. Sarah has brought in her mother Brenda's little silver locket. It was an engagement present from her husband, Sarah's father, in the 1960s but has been broken and unwearable for years. It did hold sweet pictures of the couple, but one is missing, as is the heart-shaped frame that held it in place. They lost Sarah's father a few years ago, and Sarah knows her mother would love to wear the locket again as an everyday reminder of her loving husband. Richard sets to work tackling the extreme tarnishing and crafting pieces that will allow Brenda to enjoy it once again.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team revive three treasured possessions, reigniting the memories they hold.
First into the barn is Chris Marshall from Dorset. He has come to see master hatter Jayesh Vaghela about his father's wartime Royal Australian Air Force cap. Robert Marshall served in the perilous position of rear gunner on the Lancaster bombers and completed an impressive 38 operations. During the Second World War he was posted to Britain, where he met and married Chris's mother. When the war ended, he returned to his native Australia, where he lived for the rest of his life. Although Chris only met his father a few times, he remembers a modest, kind gentleman. He would like to have the misshaped, faded cap restored as a tribute to his father's bravery and to one day pass it on to his grandson.
Mechanical maestro David Burville is also on hand to welcome Julia Ford, who has brought in a special toy from her childhood. The jointed, wooden giraffe should be strung to a sprung base, so it can move and bend when the spring is pressed or released. However, the strings have now snapped, and the geriatric giraffe is weak at the knees. He was a childhood gift from Julia's uncle Joe, who is now in his late nineties. She knows it would make his day to see the giraffe back on its feet once again.
Finally, Tracy Marriot is hoping that the barn's resident silversmith, Brenton West, can work wonders on her late mother's silver cup. Her mother, Georgina, was born in 1935, on the day of King George V's silver jubilee. Commemorative cups like these were awarded to all babies born on that special day. Tracy's mother cherished the limited-edition gift her entire life, but it has seen better days, and Tracy knows how disappointed Georgina would have been to see it in such a state. Brenton does his research and replicates the missing sections with his trusty hammers and polish.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Toy restorers Julie Tatchell and Amanda Middleditch greet Deborah Aloba, who has brought Lulu, a fragile African-Caribbean doll, to be fixed. Lulu's head has had to be taped to her body, her red dress is ripped, and her face is chipped and scratched. A pair of RAF dress boots and a ring crafted from steel by a German prisoner of war are also restored. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: Be Water
programme.desc: "Be Water" is a harrowing documentary chronicling the life of legendary actor and martial arts master, Bruce Lee. After being rejected from Hollywood, Lee returned to his parent's homeland, Hong Kong, where he'd complete four iconic films in just two years of a short career when he died at the age of 32. "Be Water" takes a look at Lee's early life in San Francisco, the son of a Chinese opera star, and troubled childhood in Hong Kong. At the age of 18, Lee established a following in Seattle by teaching Kung Fu, where he would meet his future wife Linda. When Hollywood was not ready for an Asian leading man, Lee would return to Hong Kong and become an international superstar. A trove of interviews and archival film footage illustrates the tapestry of Lee's charisma, passion, philosophy, and dedication to his art.

programme.title: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'stard
programme.desc: A documentary tribute to the influential and much-missed comedian, a man driven by punk spirit and an unrelenting commitment to pushing boundaries. When he died in 2014 at the age of 56, Rik left behind a body of ground-breaking work, from Rick the Poet and Kevin Turvey to The Young Ones, Bottom and The New Statesman - performances that redefined television comedy and helped ignite the alternative comedy revolution. The film explores his comedic journey, his creative partnership with Adrian Edmondson, his struggle with drink and the near-fatal quad-bike accident that left him fighting not only for his life but also his future. Contributors include Stephen Fry, Ben Elton, Greg Davies, Paul Jackson, John Lloyd, Nigel Planer and Adrian Edmondson

programme.desc: Part one of two. Biologist Patrick Aryee explores how cats have evolved throughout the millennia, learning to thrive in inhospitable environments, as well as becoming the world's most popular pet. In the first edition there is spectacular footage of caracals jumping three metres to catch flying birds, and a rare Bornean bay cat, which was thought to have been extinct. Patrick finds out how tigers made the transition from South-east Asia's steamy jungles to the -40C temperatures of Siberia, and meets 'lion whisperer' Kevin Richardson

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family

In Belize, he mounts an experiment that showcases the margay's supersharp senses and gravity-defying acrobatics, and heads to the training track with a cheetah to find out what speed it is capable of. Finally, Patrick tells the story of the cat's domestication in Essaouira, Morocco, believed to be one of the first places where one particular species first gave up life in the wild in return for food, warmth, security and a home

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough

One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough

Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: Stuart takes Penny out for a second date, during which she drunkenly reveals her true feelings. programme.desc: Sheldon and Howard stake their most coveted comic books on a bet over the species of a cricket, while Leonard and Penny struggle to recover from an awkward first night together. Johnny Galecki, Jim Parsons, Simon Helberg and Kaley Cuoco star

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: The youngster tries to take his mind off a difficult science problem by reading The Lord of the Rings, but this just leads to a whole new obsession. Meanwhile, Missy asks George to teach her about baseball so she can impress a boy at school

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon and the gang are excited when Barry Kripke challenges them to a robot duel. Meanwhile, Howard is devastated when Penny finally tells him what she thinks of his chauvinism. Guest starring John Ross Bowie

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon decides to put his formidable brain power to use in devising a scientific procedure for making friends. However, to prove his findings he must first win the trust of fellow scientist Barry Kripke to gain access to a powerful computer. Comedy, starring Jim Parsons and John Ross Bowie

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny runs into money troubles, so Sheldon offers to lend her some cash to help her pay the rent. However, when Leonard discovers his neighbour's ex-boyfriend Kurt is the cause of her financial woes, he gathers the gang for a confrontation. Starring Jim Parsons, Johnny Galecki and Kaley Cuoco

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard and Penny share an intimate moment as they recover from a psychological deconstruction by the physicist's mother, an expert in psychiatry and neural sciences. Guest starring Mamma Mia! actress Christine Baranski

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Tensions between Sheldon and Penny reach a new high after a paintballing accident leaves an ugly stain on the awkward physicist's favourite sofa cushion. Meanwhile, romance blossoms between Leslie and Howard. Jim Parsons and Kaley Cuoco star

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard, Sheldon, Howard and Raj discover actress Summer Glau is on their train while travelling to San Francisco. programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny starts her own hair accessories business and the orders start to pile in. However, she makes the mistake of asking Sheldon to help, leading to frustration and regret. Comedy, starring Jim Parsons and Kaley Cuoco

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny catches the eye of comic-book shopkeeper Stuart, and Leonard is devastated when she gives serious consideration to dating her new admirer. programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard and Raj take a heartbroken Howard to Las Vegas, where they pay a prostitute to spend time with him. Meanwhile, Sheldon finds himself locked out of his apartment and forced to stay the night at Penny's. With guest star Jodi Lynn O'Keefe

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Stuart takes Penny out for a second date, during which she drunkenly reveals her true feelings. programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

On their return to London, the plotters convene for the first time, and decide their moment to strike must be November 5, at the opening of Parliament. However, they must first secure gunpowder, and when a threat of detection leads to a bloody clash, Catesby puts his life on the line in an all-or-nothing mission at the Tower of London. Historical drama, starring Kit Harington, Liv Tyler and Mark Gatiss

programme.title: Gunpowder

Across the city, Father Garnet faces pressure from an ally to break his seal of confession and reveal the plot to the authorities - for the good of the already-oppressed Catholic faith. However, should the priest prove to be steadfast in his support of the would-be assassins, Lord Cecil may yet have another means by which to end Catesby's mission. Historical drama, starring Kit Harington, Mark Gatiss, Liv Tyler and Peter Mullan

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Footage of animals that live on the coast, including sea lions working in packs to hunt tuna in the shallows and moray eels that venture out of the water to seek out food on dry rocks. Puffins must brave predators to bring a mouthful of food back to their young and king penguins go without food for a month while they moult. Plus, footage of the bizarre Leaping Blenny, a fish that hates the water

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: The series concludes with a look at the ways human activity can impact on aquatic wildlife, including albatrosses unwittingly feeding their offspring plastic, mother dolphins with contaminated milk, and communications between animals being disrupted by noise. However, there are signs of hope, including the thriving Norwegian Spring-Spawning Herring, previously on the brink of extinction, and efforts to save endangered species like the whale shark and to preserve the eggs of giant leatherback turtles

programme.title: Frozen Planet

programme.title: Frozen Planet

programme.desc: The series concludes with a look at the ways human activity can impact on aquatic wildlife, including albatrosses unwittingly feeding their offspring plastic, mother dolphins with contaminated milk, and communications between animals being disrupted by noise. However, there are signs of hope, including the thriving Norwegian Spring-Spawning Herring, previously on the brink of extinction, and efforts to save endangered species like the whale shark and to preserve the eggs of giant leatherback turtles

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough travels to the Arctic and Antarctic to explore the wildernesses at Earth's poles, investigating the wildlife and geographical features found there. He begins by travelling to the North Pole, where two polar bears reveal a surprisingly tender side to their characters, before heading to the South Pole - 100 years after Roald Amundsen and Robert Falcon Scott first reached it

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: A polar bear hunts with her cubs, while the warmer weather of spring accelerates a process that will eventually see an area of ice the size of Australia disappear into the Arctic Ocean. A woolly bear caterpillar emerges from the snow after spending the winter frozen, and in Antarctica male Adelie penguins arrive to begin constructing nests in fierce storms as they try to attract mates

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Footage of animals that live on the coast, including sea lions working in packs to hunt tuna in the shallows and moray eels that venture out of the water to seek out food on dry rocks. programme.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is in Northumbria en route to the Highlands, heading to Kielder Forest to discover what lay behind a national initiative to plant one of the largest manmade woodlands in Europe. Crossing the border to Scotland, Michael arrives in the weaving town of Hawick to visit Lovat Mill, where, in the 1930s, tweed was big business, and also goes to the movies, sitting in the front stalls at the Dominion cinema in Morningside

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: In the Welsh mountains of Snowdonia, Michael Portillo reaches an abandoned mine with an art-related history. He also explores the harbour town of Porthmadog, and the fantasy village Portmeirion, crafted by architect Bertram Clough Williams-Ellis, and made famous by The Prisoner TV series

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Following the route of the old Caledonian Railway Company, Michael Portillo discovers the 'Riviera of the Highlands'. With a daily direct train service to Kings Cross, Gleneagles remains a top destination and is also headquarters for the British School of Falconry. Berry Town, aka Blairgowrie, is Michael's next stop. At the home of the Scottish raspberry industry, which once sent fruit to London daily on board a raspberry special service from Cooper Angus station, Michael learns how to pick this most delicate of berries. The last stop on this leg is the city of Dundee, where he visits publisher DC Thomson

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: In the elegant coastal town of Aberystwyth, Michael Portillo visits the National Library of Wales, set high on a hill with views over Cardigan Bay. His tour of North Wales draws to a close in style at the birthplace of the nation's first classical music festival, Gregynog Hall, near Newtown

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his great American trek, following his copy of Appleton's General Guide east from Manhattan to Long Island, and visits Brooklyn to hear the story of the construction of the world's first suspension bridge. Below ground, he investigates New York City's inaugural subway, and the dangers faced by the 'sandhogs' who built it. Progressing along the Long Island Railroad to Queens, Michael takes in an ambitious engineering project and a model town built by an Irish immigrant who became one of America's richest men. Later, he heads to the island's Gold Coast, where he relives the fun of 'the roaring twenties' at Oheka Castle, and concludes this leg of his trip at the Montauk lighthouse on Long Island's eastern-most tip

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc: Helen Skelton leads a team of experts searching for lost treasures around the Lake District and reunite them with previous owners. In the first episode, the team takes on a desperate search to find two beloved rings, and after a valuable find during an underwater search, social media detective Mui tries to track down the owner

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc: The scuba team members dive to their greatest depth yet in search of a drone for a pair of heartbroken newlyweds and social media detective Mui tries to return a phone full of memories to its rightful owner. Crafter Lucy takes on a shattered teapot fished out of the water and attempts to make something special out of it

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc:
The team battle the elements during a dive for precious graduation pictures lost by a newly qualified doctor.
Meanwhile, our crafter Jen is challenged to give an entirely new lease of life to discarded tents and camping chairs. Also, a valuable discovery is taken on by our social media detective Mui, who creates an innovative online campaign to track down the owner.

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc: A scuba team takes on a family's epic 30-year search for a grandfather's mythical missing motorbike. Meanwhile, expert social media detective Mui hunts for clues about a precious ring found on the fells and local crafter Sally is challenged to turn discarded crockery into a ceramic wonder. Presented by Helen Skelton

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: The Humber crew works closely together to pull off the risky evacuation of a fisherman with a spinal injury. On the southwest coast of Ireland, the Castletownbere team race to rescue a fishing trawler that's run aground near Dursey Island, and is in danger of breaking up on the rocks. The village of Clovelly's crew assist a yacht that has lost all power - a rescue made all the more difficult by severe weather

programme.title: Train Rescue Down Under
programme.desc: A maintenance team attempts to overhaul a finicky gearbox while another team must shunt an electric passenger train across multiple rail crossings during peak hour.

programme.title: Martin Clunes: A Man and His Dogs
programme.desc: Part one of two. The actor explores the ancient ancestry of domestic dogs and discovers why their relationship with humans has been so successful. Travelling across the globe, from dog shows in London to the wilderness of the Australian Outback, he unravels the links that have made man and beast inseparable for 15,000 years

programme.title: Martin Clunes: A Man and His Dogs
programme.desc: The actor concludes his two-part documentary with a look at man's relationship with his best friend. He considers how dogs' abilities have been harnessed to good effect in pursuits ranging from tracking and herding to assisting the police and disabled people. Martin also explores how selective breeding has damaged the health of many breeds, and concludes by asking what would happen if dogs simply walked away from the relationship

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie returns to where his boating life began, exploring London's canals on Naughty Lass. He travels through Little Venice and moors in Paddington Basin.

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie mends a leaky pump on the Naughty Lass on the Grand Union Canal. In Watford, he visits a TV legend's home and buys gas from a friendly fuel boat.

programme.title: Michael Palin: Travels of a Lifetime
programme.desc: Michael revisits his six-part travel series Himalaya, one of the most extraordinary and challenging journeys he has embarked upon in his career

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: With the arrival of autumn the Arctic Ocean begins freezing over, and polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast as they await the return of the ice. Two thousand beluga whales head for a particular estuary to thrash against the gravel and exfoliate, while in Antarctica, Adelie penguins take to the sea for the first time and face the danger of leopard seal attacks

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines how the arrival of winter sparks a ruthless battle for survival in the polar regions, with temperatures plummeting to -70C, winds reaching 120mph and day-long darkness. As a blizzard rages, a polar bear treks into the Arctic mountains to give birth, while the entire world population of spectacled eider braves the weather in a giant ice hole. Wolves and bison engage in battle, but alliances are also made, and beneath the snow, voles try to dodge the attacks of great grey owls and weasels

It will take the combined efforts of three of the Repair Shop's finest experts to bring it back to life.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: By the late 1920s, Europe appeared to have put the bad old days of economic strife behind them but a few voices warned that this boom time would have consequences

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: In the 20's there seemed to be some good candidates for leadership in Europe but they all disappeared when the great depression hit and lives across the world are ruined

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: With the United States also suffering, Japan took the opportunity to increase their empire. Turning their attention to East Asia, they plotted the invasion of Manchuria

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: By the mid thirties, Adolf Hitler's ambitions seemed clear to all. If the great powers had acted earlier, would their intervention have prevented WW2?

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: For some, appeasement was the only way repeating the disaster of the First World War. . But as the documentary reveals, with Adolf Hitler at the other end of the negotiating table, this was a strategy doomed to failure

programme.title: Women of World War II: More Untold Stories
programme.desc: With rare archival footage and revealing interviews, this documentary tells the unknown stories of the women who enabled Allied victory in the Second World War. It honours their accomplishments with moving tributes from the history-makers and people they inspired.

programme.title: The Sunday Show
programme.desc: Gary Robertson looks at the main issues from the world of politics and beyond, featuring interviews, discussion and analysis on the stories that matter to Scotland

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Sportscene: Premiership Highlights
programme.desc: Action from the latest matches, featuring Celtic v Kilmarnock at Celtic Park and Hearts v Falkirk at Tynecastle. Plus, a round-up of yesterday's action

programme.title: Hamza's Hidden Wild Isles
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin records wildlife around the UK during summer, travelling from the vast open ocean of the Irish sea to the heart of Leeds and his remote home on Scotland's west coast. Along the way, he encounters a two-metre long blue shark, pregnant greater horseshoe bats, a pod of common dolphins, and wild beavers, which have been missing from Britain for the past 400 years

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Documentary about Police Scotland's Highlands and Islands division, revealing what it takes to patrol and keep the peace in one of the most beautiful and challenging places in Britain

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Jack and Victor become radio DJs at the hospital, but Winston is less than impressed with the venture, and gives them a particularly unflattering nickname. Meanwhile, Navid also visits the medical centre, but for a more serious reason

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: Cyber cop Archie Pepper gets a new colleague and is soon overcome by red hot passion. Urban beat team Fletcher and McLaren calm down a celebrity fracas in a city centre chip shop. Bobby desperately seeks advice from Officer Karen on his face-covering, while the traffic cops lift a street vigilante planting greenery in potholes

programme.title: Breaking the News
programme.desc: Des Clarke hosts the topical comedy news quiz, with panellists Kate Hammer, Geoff Norcott, Amy Matthews and Ray Bradshaw taking a satirical swipe at the week's news

programme.title: Our Lives: Speed Without Limits
programme.desc: Following Scotland's first wheelchair-using racing driver, Ally Chalmers, as he prepares for his debut season in the ModSports Championship at Knockhill Racing Circuit - a mixed-class event in which he will share the track with cars much more powerful than his own. Ally's mechanic Scott has built him a customised Mini race car fitted with hand controls but technical gremlins and mechanical misalignments spark concern as to whether it will be race-ready by the start of the season

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Splitsville
programme.desc: When Ashley asks husband Carey for a divorce, he turns to friends Julie and Paul for support. Carey is stunned to discover their secret to happiness is an open marriage. However, when Carey and Julie cross a line, the arrangement unleashes jealousy and chaos, forcing both couples to confront what they want from love and commitment. Romantic comedy, starring Dakota Johnson, Adria Arjona, and Michael Angelo Covino, who also co-wrote and directed

programme.title: Midwinter Break
programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Racewalkers
programme.desc: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural talent for the sport as they challenge the sport's top competitor. Comedy, directed by and starring Kevin Claydon and Phil Moniz

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Reminders of Him
programme.desc: Kenna Rowan emerges from a seven-year prison sentence, and returns to the hometown where she was held legally responsible for the death of her boyfriend, Scotty Landry. She is grimly resolved to confront ghosts of the past so she can finally meet the daughter she was forced to give up. Drama, starring Maika Monroe

programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Forbidden Fruits
programme.desc: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch coven with co-workers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin challenges their sisterhood, forcing the trio to confront their inner darkness. As tensions rise and the coven's secrets threaten to spill, they must face their fears or all meet a violent end. Comedy horror, starring Lili Reinhart

Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Emilia Clarke, Henry Golding and Emma Thompson. London, 2017: life could be better for twenty-something chaos magnet Kate, who has her heart set on being a singer but works all year round as an elf in a Covent Garden store. Then she meets too-good-to-be true Tom. Could romance be in the air?

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart and Anna Faris. Chris was once an overweight loser, but is now slim, successful and a compulsive womaniser. Returning to his home town, he becomes determined to win the heart of the girl who was his best friend in high school.

programme.title: Genie
programme.desc: Seasonal fantasy comedy starring Melissa McCarthy and Paapa Essiedu. Workaholic Bernard is having a pretty bad Christmas: his wife has left him, he's been fired and he's all alone. But things take a surprising turn when he unwittingly releases a genie from a jewellery box and is granted unlimited wishes. Could Bernard be about to get his life back together?

programme.title: The Night Before Christmas In Wonderland
programme.desc: Animated musical fantasy featuring the voices of Gerard Butler and Emilia Clarke. When St Nick receives a letter from the Princess of Hearts in Wonderland, he assembles his reindeer and flies down the rabbit hole to the topsy-turvy realm. But when he arrives, he falls foul of a grumpy queen who has banned Christmas. Can he cheer her up and persuade her to change her mind?

programme.title: All I Want for Christmas
programme.desc: A young girl with divorced parents, whose mother is about to remarry, asks Santa to bring them back together.

programme.title: A Boy Called Christmas
programme.desc: Seasonal adventure starring Henry Lawfull, Toby Jones and Sally Hawkins, based on the bestseller by Matt Haig. At Christmas, three children are told the story of Nikolas, a young Finnish boy searching for a magical elf kingdom. Along for the ride are a talking mouse and a friendly reindeer, as Nikolas embarks on a quest that will see his name go down in history.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: Animated fantasy based on the book by Dr Seuss, featuring the voice of Benedict Cumberbatch. The embittered, mountain-dwelling Grinch plots to ruin the festive season for the cheery citizens of Whoville. That is until he finds his spirits unexpectedly lifted by a young girl and her family.

programme.title: Nativity!
programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Freeman. Despite being traumatised by a bad review years earlier, primary school teacher Paul Maddens is tasked with directing the annual Nativity play. Taunted by a teacher from a rival school, Paul foolishly promises that an old flame, now a Hollywood producer, is coming to see his production.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: Seasonal animated fantasy featuring Tom Hanks. On Christmas Eve, a young boy lies in bed pondering if Santa Claus really exists. Startled by a thunderous sound, he goes outside to discover a magical train destined for the North Pole. As he cautiously climbs on board, he begins an amazing journey that changes his view of the festive season for ever.

programme.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Jim Carrey. It's Christmas in Whoville and preparations are well under way. Meanwhile, up in his mountain lair, cold-hearted hermit the Grinch sits alone resenting the Whovians' happiness. But then he's befriended by a little girl.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy fantasy starring Will Ferrell and James Caan. Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Black comedy horror starring Zach Galligan and Phoebe Cates. In a small American town, kindly inventor Rand Peltzer brings home a cute little animal called a mogwai for his son Billy, with three rules for its upkeep: never get the mogwai wet, expose him to light or feed him after midnight. Accidentally, these rules get broken and all hell breaks loose.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: Seasonal animated fantasy featuring Tom Hanks. On Christmas Eve, a young boy lies in bed pondering if Santa Claus really exists. Startled by a thunderous sound, he goes outside to discover a magical train destined for the North Pole. As he cautiously climbs on board, he begins an amazing journey that changes his view of the festive season for ever.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: A stressed businessman just wants to make it home to spend Thanksgiving with his family. However, when his flight is forced to land miles from its destination, he finds himself sharing a disaster-strewn journey across America with an amiable but slobbish salesman. Comedy road movie, starring Steve Martin, John Candy, Laila Robins, Kevin Bacon and Michael McKean

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Frank Capra's classic fantasy drama, starring James Stewart, Donna Reed and Lionel Barrymore. George Bailey is a small-town businessman who believes he has been a failure. Contemplating suicide, George meets his guardian angel and discovers what life in his home town of Bedford Falls would have been like had he never lived.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson and Kim Basinger. In the rotten heart of Gotham City, wrongdoers face a new nemesis: a caped crusader cracking down on crime. Photojournalist Vicki Vale's investigations take her to a party given by easy-going millionaire playboy Bruce Wayne. Meanwhile, dapper mobster Jack Napier becomes a fall guy for his criminal kingpin boss and undergoes a terrible transformation, emerging as a twisted villain destined to pose a deadly threat to Vicki and the mysterious Batman.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: Sequel to the 1989 action fantasy Batman, starring Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Michelle Pfeiffer. The Caped Crusader returns to action when Gotham City is threatened by corrupt tycoon Max Shreck and the vengeful Penguin. As he battles the forces of crime, Batman discovers a deadly new foe in the shape of feline vigilante, Catwoman.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Jim Carrey, Nicole Kidman and Chris O'Donnell. Former district attorney Harvey Two-Face holds Batman responsible for the attack that left half of his face disfigured, while brilliant scientist Edward Nygma bears a grudge against Batman's alter ego, Bruce Wayne, for rejecting one of his experiments. The pair decide to combine forces to exact their revenge.
