programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: On the isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been enemies for generations, young warrior Hiccup breaks tradition by forming an unlikely bond with Toothless, a feared Night Fury. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Mason Thames, Nico Parker and Gerard Butler

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: Four misfits are yanked through a strange portal into a cubic realm powered by imagination. To return home, they must learn its rules and journey alongside an unlikely master crafter. Director Jared Hess's blockbusting fantasy adventure based on the hit videogame, starring Jack Black, Jason Momoa, Emma Myers and Jennifer Coolidge

programme.title: Fantastic Mr Fox
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of George Clooney, Meryl Streep and Bill Murray. Following the birth of their son, Mr Fox agrees to keep his word to his wife that his wild days are behind him. But when the family moves to a new home overlooking the farms of Boggis, Bunce and Bean, Mr Fox is tempted to resume his old poaching ways.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Michael Caine and Josh Hutcherson. A teenage adventurer locates an island inhabited by monster lizards, giant bees and a gold volcano.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Super Charlie
programme.desc: Willie's dream of fighting crime with his cop dad is shattered when his baby brother Charlie arrives. And the new family member turns out to have superpowers. Family animation, with the voices of Karen Ardiff and Alex Kelly

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Steve Carell. Behind the seemingly tranquil façade of small-town America, super-criminal Gru plots his biggest heist yet: to steal the Moon. But an encounter with orphan sisters Margo, Edith and Agnes proves that even the most dastardly villain has a soft centre.

programme.title: Despicable Me 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Steve Carell and Kristen Wiig. The Anti-Villain League recruits former supervillain Gru to lead an investigation and find the person responsible for stealing a secret Arctic laboratory.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig and Trey Parker. Having already acquired a wife and three orphan daughters, reformed supervillain Gru now discovers that he has a long-lost twin, Dru. But Dru is hoping he can convince his brother to return to his wicked ways...

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Sandra Bullock. The film charts the history of the diminutive yellow sidekicks as they seek to serve the biggest villains around - everyone from Dracula to Napoleon, all the way up to their introduction to Gru, their evil leader in Despicable Me.

programme.title: Charlie the Wonderdog
programme.desc: A dog gains superpowers after he is abducted by aliens. Together, they battle an evil cat threatening humanity while the canine becomes a famous superhero. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Owen Wilson and Vincent Tong

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jackie Chan, Dave Franco and Justin Theroux as the Lego figures. Teenager Lloyd is secretly part of a team of heroes who protect their city from the evil Lord Garmadon - who happens to be Lloyd's father.

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring James Cromwell. Babe, an orphaned pig, is raised on a farm by the sheepdog Fly. Although he is destined for the dinner table, Babe astonishes Farmer Hoggett and his fellow farmyard animals when he shows talent as a "sheep-pig".

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: Action spy thriller starring Tom Cruise. The world has been plunged into chaos by the machinations of all-powerful sentient AI "the Entity", which has sown misinformation and distrust among nations and citizens. Only rogue US agent Ethan Hunt has the means to stop the Entity and avert armageddon - but can he and his team stay one step ahead?

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Jet Li. A highly skilled group of mercenaries are commissioned by a shady operative to assassinate the murderous dictator of a South American island. But they should know that an operation like this is never straightforward.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Bruce Willis. The crack team of mercenaries take on what looks like the easy job of retrieving an item from a crashed plane in Albania. But when one of the group is murdered by an international arms dealer, it turns into a mission of revenge.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone. Mercenary Barney Ross decides to retire his ageing band of cohorts and replace them with younger models for a mission to capture a ruthless adversary from his past. But when things get sticky, help comes from an unlikely direction.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Period horror adventure sequel starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker and Vin Diesel. When illegal street racer Dominic Toretto is suspected of being the mastermind behind a series of truck hijacks, undercover police officer Brian O'Conner is sent to infiltrate his gang. But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker. Disgraced cop Brian O'Conner is given the chance to redeem himself by going under cover to entrap a powerful Miami drugs baron.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
programme.desc: Action thriller sequel starring Lucas Black. To avoid jail for illegal street racing, a bad-boy teenager is sent to Japan to stay with his estranged father. However, his discovery of drifting, a new style of racing reliant on the use of oversteering, soon gets him into more trouble.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery and Denholm Elliott. When archaeologist Henry Jones disappears, his son Indiana joins in the search for him. In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Fantasy horror comedy starring Bruce Campbell and Embeth Davidtz. The second sequel to the original Evil Dead finds Ash back in medieval times and desperate to return to the present. But to do so, it means having to take up arms against an army of familiar old foes.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jackie Chan. On an assignment to track down an arms dealer in Australia, a Hong Kong policeman makes contact with the local Triad and discovers that the Russian intelligence officer who recruited him has criminal motives.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Unmissable Sky Originals
programme.desc: Dive into a world of unmissable Sky Original films, from psychological thriller To Catch a Killer to the Oscar-nominated The Unites States vs Billie Holiday

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kerwin Mathews. Blown off course to the monster-infested island of Colossa, Sinbad and his crew rescue a sorcerer from the clutches of a cyclops. The voyage continues to Baghdad, but the sorcerer has been forced to leave stolen property behind, and hatches a wicked plan to force Sinbad to return to Colossa.

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart and Doug McClure. Loner Charlie Anderson keeps his family out of the Civil War, even though there is fighting a few miles from his Virginia farm. But when his new son-in-law joins the Confederate army and his youngest son is captured by Federal troops, Charlie finds he can no longer ignore the conflict.

programme.title: Rumble in the Bronx
programme.desc: Martial arts crime drama starring Jackie Chan. A Hong Kong policeman visiting New York for the wedding of a relative becomes involved in a battle against a gang that's conducting a campaign of terror in the Bronx.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford and Karen Allen. Indiana Jones's outrageous exploits take him around the world in search of the legendary Ark of the Covenant, a religious artefact of unspeakable power wanted by the Nazis. With the help of an old flame, Indy takes on his enemies in a terrifying and death-defying battle to the finish.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery and Denholm Elliott. When archaeologist Henry Jones disappears, his son Indiana joins in the search for him. In a desperate race against time, Indy encounters some old enemies and once again finds himself in pursuit of an ancient religious artefact.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy featuring the music of Abba, and starring Meryl Streep, Colin Firth and Pierce Brosnan. On an idyllic Greek island, young Sophie Sheridan prepares to marry the man of her dreams. But a problem looks set to blight the big day as the bride doesn't know who her father is. So Sophie sends out invitations to three men who might fit the bill, hoping to solve the riddle once her guests arrive.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy sequel starring Lily James, Amanda Seyfried and Jeremy Irvine and featuring the songs of Abba. A now happily married Sophie prepares to reopen her late mother Donna's hotel. Meanwhile flashbacks show a young Donna discovering Greece and falling in love - several times.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs. Four teenage boys pledge to lose their virginity before their high-school prom, but their efforts have hilarious and outrageous consequences.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Al Pacino, John Cazale and Charles Durning. On a hot August day in 1972, Sonny Wortzik and two accomplices enter a Brooklyn bank and hold the staff at gunpoint. But the robbery goes wrong and when police surround the building, Sonny and his morose friend Sal become trapped inside with their hostages.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: Absolution
programme.desc: A veteran gangster tries to reconnect with his kids and amend the mistakes of his past, but escaping from his nefarious former colleagues proves harder than expected. Thriller, starring Liam Neeson, Ron Perlman and Frankie Shaw

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller, directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his assistant Dr John Watson think they have seen the back of serial killer Lord Blackwood. But when the evil occultist apparently comes back from the dead, they are once again drawn into a dangerous game.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his trusty assistant Dr Watson are once again drawn into a battle of wits with arch nemesis Professor Moriarty. And this time the evil genius's plan could spell disaster for the whole of Europe.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Audrey Tautou. When the victim of a ritualised killing is discovered at the Louvre, French cryptographer Sophie Neveu and Harvard professor Robert Langdon are called in to try to identify strange symbols cut into the body. They become embroiled in a deadly conspiracy that has shattering ramifications for Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on Dan Brown's forerunner to The Da Vinci Code, starring Tom Hanks and Ayelet Zurer. With the election of a new pope imminent, the Illuminati kidnap the four leading contenders and issue a coded message that they will murder the men and blow up the Vatican. Catholic leaders turn to Harvard symbolist Robert Langdon, who must put his uneasy relationship with the church hierarchy aside in an effort to crack the code and save the men's lives.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestseller by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Felicity Jones. Renowned symbologist Dr Robert Langdon wakes up in a Florence hospital with a head injury and no memory of the previous 48 hours. However, he soon finds himself hunted and forced to undertake a globe-trotting race against time to prevent the release of a deadly virus capable of killing half the world's population.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Biographical musical drama starring Taron Egerton and Jamie Bell. From the safety of an addiction rehab group, a flamboyantly dressed man recalls the highs and lows of his childhood and transformation from talented young pianist Reggie Dwight into global superstar Elton John.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: Cool Hand Luke
programme.desc: Prison drama starring Paul Newman and George Kennedy. After being sentenced to two years on a chain gang, Luke Jackson is faced with the unrelenting demands of the camp's daily routine. However, his resilience quickly antagonises the gang boss.

programme.title: Plainclothes
programme.desc: An undercover agent assigned to lure and arrest gay men defies orders when he falls for a target. Writer/director Carmen Emmi's thriller, starring Tom Blyth, Russell Tovey and Maria Dizzia

programme.title: Widow Clicquot
programme.desc: Biographical romantic drama starring Haley Bennett. In 1805 France, Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin Clicquot is suddenly widowed at just 27 years old, but vows to continue her late husband's champagne business. Though many, including her father-in-law, are sceptical, Barbe-Nicole works tirelessly to innovate and succeed.

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Drama starring Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington and Jason Robards. Andrew Beckett's career at a prestigious law firm appears to be taking off. But Beckett hasn't revealed to his employers that he is gay or that he is HIV positive. When Beckett is suddenly sacked after falling ill, he contacts lawyer Joe Miller in a bid to sue the company for wrongful dismissal.

programme.title: Rocketman

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody

So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Thriller starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn and Chase Infiniti. Years after the collapse of his political revolutionary group, Bob Ferguson lives in paranoid seclusion with his teenage daughter, Willa. But the merciless Colonel Lockjaw, a one-time target of Bob's group, has been hunting its members ever since, and has unfinished business with Bob.

programme.title: Cool Hand Luke
programme.desc: Prison drama starring Paul Newman and George Kennedy. After being sentenced to two years on a chain gang, Luke Jackson is faced with the unrelenting demands of the camp's daily routine. However, his resilience quickly antagonises the gang boss.

After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: Green Lantern

programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Lake Placid

In annual retribution for a failed uprising in the totalitarian state of Panem, each of 12 districts is forced to select a young boy and girl to take part in a televised fight to the death. programme.desc: Sunderland v Chelsea (Kick-off 2.00pm). Coverage of the Premier League match from Stadium of Light. The hosts did the league double over their visitors last season thanks to two 2-1 victories. Sunderland scored a late winner at Stamford Bridge in the first game back in October thanks to a goal from Chemsdine Talbi in the 93rd minute as they came from a goal down. The reverse fixture at this ground in May then saw the Black Cats hold on to a 2-1 lead despite Cole Palmer's goal in the 56th minute

programme.title: Live Super Sunday
programme.desc: Manchester United v Aston Villa (Kick-off 4.30pm). Coverage of the Premier League match from Old Trafford. The reverse fixture back in December at Villa Park saw Morgan Rogers score a brace to give the Midlands club a 2-1 victory on home soil

programme.desc: Liverpool v Arsenal (Kick-off 12.00pm). Coverage of the Women's Super League match from Anfield. programme.title: Live NFL
programme.desc: Atlanta Falcons v Cincinnati Bengals (Kick-off 2.30pm). Coverage of the week nine match from Bernabeu in Madrid, as the NFL comes to Spain for the second year in a row. Last year's game at this stadium saw the Washington Commanders take on the Miami Dolphins in a thrilling game that saw the Dolphins win 16-13 in over-time. Today's meeting between the Falcons and the Bengals is the first time the sides have met since October 2022 when Cincinnati claimed an impressive 35-17 victory at home

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: Food enthusiast and baker Briony May Williams travels the length of Italy to ask: are Italians too fussy about their food? The United Nations cultural body Unesco has recently given the country's entire cooking tradition special status - that's everything from pasta to pizza, mozzarella to tiramisu. But many Italians have strong opinions about how, when and what to eat, and some unwitting faux pas from visitors can send purists into a frenzy. Briony meets the innovators adding controversial ingredients to pizza and new flavours to ice cream, and the traditionalists who want to keep things exactly as they are.

programme.desc:
Evan is furious with Polly for revealing the secrets of his home life to her mum. He was doing fine. Now what will happen to him and his dad? He will never forgive her. Mrs Morgan has called a vote of no confidence in Bell after the frequency of incidents involving badly-behaved pupils. Bell decides he can persuade the other governors the school is okay by staging a prize-giving to celebrate the outstanding achievements of Elmsmere students.
Bell suggests to Owen and Chester that one of them will be announced as Star Pupil at the end of the day. But in doing so they trash the place, and instead of being crowned star pupil they are both sent home with a letter to their parents about their terrible behaviour.
Through a misunderstanding, Eli believes he is going to be awarded Star Pupil. He eventually decides to turn the award down (confusing Bell, who was never going to give it to him in the first place). Eli remains convinced the award was his for the taking.
Polly decides Evan will feel less left out if he's voted as Pupil of the Year. Bell dismisses the idea as absurd.
Eventually Polly bursts into a meeting and tells everyone they can't send Evan away. But it's Evan who calms her down. He tells her his dad wasn't coping, that the intervention is good and that he needs the help. He's going to stay with his aunt - in Wales.
Polly wonders what will happen with her relationship with Evan long term - but for now, things feel better.
And for her selflessness in trying to help Evan, it's Polly who is voted Pupil of the Year.
Danny decides to award some alternative prizes to the less able kids. Fleur is scornful - until she gets a good friendship prize for helping Polly and realises that school really can celebrate more than just academic achievements.
Nunn and Isaac decide to settle a bet over whose job has the best equipment by having a lawnmower and floor-polisher race. programme.title: Jane McDonald: Cruising the Blue Danube
programme.desc: Jane travels along the Danube on one of the most luxurious ships of its type, as she makes a foray into the realms of the river cruise. Beginning in Budapest, Jane heads to the Szechenyi Baths, where she indulges in a game of chess. Afterwards, a visit to the Second World War memorial Shoes on the Danube Bank, leaves her in tears. Heading onwards to Vienna, the presenter is all set to meet a real-life princess. Then, after a waltz and a wurst, Jane makes her way to her final stop of Passau, southern Bavaria, to view its charming architecture

programme.title: Jane McDonald: Cruising Italy
programme.desc: The Mediterranean leg of Jane's journey begins as she sails through the impressive 19th-century Corinth canal, a man-made waterway that connects the Aegean and Ionian seas to reach Italy. The singer visits historic Gallipoli in southern Italy and savours the famous local delicacy - purple prawns. After catching up with cruising first-timers over sunset cocktails, she sails to Sicily to hitch a ride on a vintage three-wheeler around the medieval town of Savoca, immortalised by the Godfather movie trilogy

programme.title: Na Trads - An Dara Teud 2025
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Alistair Heather present highlights from the 2025 Trad Awards from Aberdeen Music Hall, with performances by Mec Lir, Mairi MacInnes, Rory Matheson Dance Band, Ellie Beaton and Ross Miller Band among others. The presenters also catch up with winners and stars of the event - both onstage and behind the scenes

programme.desc: In commemoration of Remembrance Sunday, the Rev Angus Smith explores the role of faith in war and loss. Glasgow Gaelic Choir performs Psalm 124 and Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir sings the hymn Nam Aonar le mo Smuaintinn. Presented by Iain MacKinnon

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets singer Mary Ann Kennedy in Ardgour. Although born in Glasgow, Mary Ann discusses how she has made her home in Ardgour and what that means to her. As they walk along Cona Glen, Mary Ann opens up about feeling comfortable in her own skin and how the environment has helped her find peace. She chats about her changing relationship with music and what brings her happiness

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Erica Macpherson transforms rooms, homes and businesses, demonstrating the process from architectural plans to trawling auction houses and shops for finishing touches

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh
programme.desc: Calum Maclean explores the underground sites of central Scotland. First, author Mairi Kidd introduces him to a lesser known history of Edinburgh below the city streets. Then he ventures under the busy platforms of Glasgow Central Station, where Calum discovers an atmospheric disused Victorian platform. In Dunoon, Calum gets help from his friend Kenny Rankin to access the Paper Caves and find out more about a story that dates back almost 350 years, connecting the Campbell clan with the site

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy heads to Northern Ireland to visit a good friend in County Down. Pól Mac Cana is an expert in foraging around his locality, and the two harvest sloes near the house to make a tasty gin that will be ready for the end of the series. They also pick some ribwort plantain, and Pól shows Mary Ann how to use it to make a health remedy. Mary Ann and Lucy Cooke consider the different laws that have a bearing on land access in Scotland, Northern Ireland and England

programme.title: Seirm: Celtic Connections
programme.desc: Traditional music show from Celtic Connections 2024. Mary Ann Kennedy presents a cross section of music with performances from Kathryn Tickell and the Darkening, Ewen Henderson, Genticorum and intimate session recordings with TEUD and Kaia Kater

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean (Wild Senses)
programme.desc: The varied ways animals use super-senses to navigate the world, from high-resolution vision to fish that taste with their skin. The series reveals how tigers turn orange into camouflage, dolphins navigate the deep using echo-location, raccoons feel their way with hyper-sensitive paws and even trees send out chemical alarms. In Gaelic

The 1976 Formula One season is dominated by the intense rivalry between two brilliant drivers: the maverick James Hunt and the methodical Niki Lauda. As their quest for dominance of the sport grows more intense, tragedy seems almost inevitable.

programme.title: War Horse
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's adaptation of Michael Morpurgo's First World War drama, starring Emily Watson, David Thewlis and Jeremy Irvine. Dartmoor, 1914: when Ted Narracott buys a thoroughbred horse for his farm, his son Albert soon bonds with the animal who he names Joey. However, when the harvest fails and war is declared on Germany, Ted is forced to sell Joey to the British Army. Albert enlists but can he and Joey survive the horrors of the Front to be reunited?

programme.title: Planet Earth: A Tale of Three Bears
programme.desc: Julia Bradbury and wildlife expert Lynn Rogers explore the Northwoods of Minnesota, following three black bear cubs and learning the dangers they face in the wild. The infant creatures are desirable prey for roaming coyotes and wolves, and combined with the threat posed by hunters and changeable weather conditions, their survival depends entirely on how well they learn skills from their mother

programme.title: Oul Treasures
programme.desc: Lolly Spence searches for more family heirlooms and prized possessions in desperate need of repair from the country's finest craftspeople. She begins Carnalbanagh, an Ulster-Scots townland high in the hills of Co Antrim, where a lost record of community life has recently been uncovered after an old biscuit tin was found to contain reels of film

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Adam Henson explore how dairy farmers across County Antrim, one of Northern Ireland's most productive dairy regions, are turning to tech and innovative business models to build a more resilient future. Adam also introduces this year's BBC Food and Farming Awards Countryfile Young Countryside Champion nominees

programme.title: The Reluctant Vampire
programme.desc: The day of Val's initiation ceremony approaches, and he still has no idea how he'll pass the vampire test. When his final plan doesn't work out, he realises he can no longer live a double life and is faced with the ultimate dilemma. Should he come clean and risk everything for the chance of a human life or sacrifice who he really is for the sake of his family?

programme.title: Murder in Belfast - Sisters Seeking Justice
programme.desc: The final part of the investigation into Robert McCartney's murder. Police believe they are closer to catching Robert's killers, but have to contend with the fact that some witnesses have also been talking to the IRA. As the political ramifications of the murder settle, a trial finally looms and Robert's family hope that their years of battling have put justice in reach

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Crystal Palace v Liverpool at Selhurst Park and Manchester United v Aston Villa at Villa Park. Palace took the honours against the Reds in three of their meetings with them last term, but Andoni Iraola's men had proved difficult to beat on their travels so far in the current campaign. Elsewhere, the Villans will have been looking to inflict more misery upon a struggling United side. Plus, Brighton & Hove Albion v Brentford, Ipswich Town v Bournemouth and Sunderland v Chelsea

programme.title: The Taste of Things
programme.desc: Period romantic drama starring Benoît Magimel and Juliette Binoche. On a beautiful estate in late 19th-century France, renowned gourmet Dodin works alongside his lover, the talented cook Eugénie. But despite the harmony of their unconventional relationship, all he really wants is her hand in marriage.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: Cheryl returns to Liverpool with devastating news for Michael. With no way out, Michael is forced to make an impossible decision to protect the one he loves. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the Phelans as they hunt Banksey, unaware a new enemy is moving in the shadows

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Singer and West End star Sam Ryder, veteran broadcaster Jeff Stelling and Brit Award-winning singer Ella Eyre - each accompanied by a friend or family member - take on the challenge. The line-up is completed by Princess and Junior Andre - the children of Peter Andre and Katie Price - as the four pairs embark on an epic 7,500km race from the prehistoric jungles of Borneo to the sun-baked southern tip of Australia. The competitors cross three countries and two continents, weaving through five checkpoints, before reaching the finish line in Melbourne

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: Mid Wales is the destination for this part of Christine Walkden's balloon tour of some of Britain's finest gardens. She learns how to brace an ancient yew in the grounds of Powis Castle, and helps restore an obscured view at the Dingle Garden. Plus, the story of Mona Holloway, a wartime land girl who found love on a neighbouring farm

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Vick Hope discovers how a team from a small Gloucestershire hamlet made it into the professional leagues, before trying her hand at mowing the pitch with the club's groundsman. Matt Baker follows the making of an organic beer and meets the greengrocer supplying fresh produce to the world's first fully vegan football club. Adam Henson heads to Yorkshire to find some fresh recruits for his White Park herd back in Gloucestershire

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond heads to the annual autumn calf sale in the historic Newton Stewart mart to see how this special building is still going strong a century after it was built. Cammy Wilson is also in Dumfries and Galloway, near Lockerbie, investigating what the arrival of the bluetongue virus means for Scottish farmers. Shahbaz Majeed is on the Morvern Peninsula heading underground to explore Europe's only silica sand mine and, ahead of Children in Need, Arlene Stuart is near Selkirk in the Borders visiting a charity that uses the healing power of horses

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway recalls his most terrific treks from the South, looking back on explorations of Caerphilly and Castell Coch and the time he discovered a clifftop hideaway while on a walk from Fall Bay to Oxwich. He also reminisces on his time in Wye Valley where he took one of the UK's first tourist walks, took to the water in a canoe and visited the awe-inspiring Tintern Abbey

programme.title: Swallows and Amazons
programme.desc: Adventure based on Arthur Ransome's classic children's novel, starring Rafe Spall and Kelly Macdonald. England in the 1930s: while on holiday in the Lake District, the four Walker children dub themselves the "Swallows" (after their sailboat) and lay claim to a nearby island where they set up camp. However, the local Blackett sisters ("the Amazons") consider that spot to be their domain, so before long battle lines are drawn.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva heads to Domaine Dujac, home of the current most-wanted Burgundy wine. Burgundy's rich soil and savoir faire are parents to many culinary classics. At a local winery, Eva tucks into beef cheeks bathed in Domaine Dujac for a classic boeuf bourguignon lunch

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Eric Knowles is in Kingston in Surrey, where the teams are led by Thomas Forrester and Gary Pe. While the competition hots up, Eric gets on his bike at the Herne Hill Velodrome

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Dion Dublin and Tommy Walsh follow the progress of properties in the process of changing hand. Tommy is on the coast in the Norfolk village of Eccles-on-Sea to see a very unusual, wooden constructed property that he fears may be beyond salvation. He's also in Islington, north London, living the high life at a two-bed flat situated in one of the upper floors of a high-rise building. Dion is in Sheffield to view an intriguing auction lot comprising of three terraced houses

programme.title: Match of the Day Live: The FA Cup
programme.desc: Cray Wanderers v Stockport County (Kick-off 2.15pm). All the action from the first-round tie, held at Flamingo Park. The Wanderers are one of the oldest football clubs in the world, but this is the Isthmian League outfit's first appearance in the first-round proper of this competition. They face a tough test against County, who earned promotion back into the Football League in the 2021/22 season, and have finished third in League One in each of the last two campaigns

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress learns about the art of patisserie in Paris, which is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world, sampling the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and a dahlia

programme.title: MOTD: FA Cup Highlights
programme.desc: Action from the first-round ties, including Wimborne Town v Crawley Town at The Wyatt Homes Stadium, Stafford Rangers v Grimsby Town at Marston Road and Cray Wanderers v Stockport County at Flamingo Park. In all three fixtures, the semi-professional hosts were looking to cause major upsets against Football League opposition

programme.title: Scrum V
programme.desc: Lauren Salter is joined by Shane Williams, Richie Rees and Tom Shanklin as they break down Wales' Nations Championship match against Japan at Principality Stadium

programme.title: Remembrance Sunday: The Cenotaph Highlights
programme.desc: Coverage of this morning's service as the King led the commemorations from Whitehall in central London alongside representatives of the armed forces, the Commonwealth and faith communities. The two-minute silence at 11 am and the National Service of Remembrance was followed by the wreath laying and historic march past of 10,000 veterans in recognition of all those who have died serving their countries

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents the show from Crystal Palace Park in south-east London, where she is joined by cartoonist Ralph Steadman. Items brought in to be valued include a trio of bronze Chinese censers, a rare sundial by Thomas Tuttell from the 17th century, and a rare do it yourself kit dress by fashion designer Paco Rabanne. Mark Smith challenges Fiona to identify secret Second World War spy gadgets concealed in everyday items

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul head to Shetland to fish the lochs and the seas of this remote and beautiful archipelago for trout and pollock. The archipelago of about 100 islands off the north-east coast of Scotland is the furthest place in the UK they have travelled to fish, and it is wild and full of surprises for both of them

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After a hair-raising drive across the Conor Pass and a spot of seaside silliness hitting golf balls into the ocean, Bill Murray bids farewell to Chris O'Dowd. In County Clare, Bill and his friend Tom Coyne's attempt to sneak unnoticed into a hurling match goes awry, before an emotional reunion recalls an unforgettable act of kindness. Then, a chance invitation in Ballybunion leads to a freezing Atlantic challenge

programme.title: Later... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Taking to the stage at Alexandra Palace Theatre in north London are Jamie T, Antony Szmierek, Violet Grohl, Emily Bear and Tia Gordon. Also appearing is Leo Sayer, who chats to Jools about his career and performs his 1977 classic When I Need You

programme.title: Helmand: Tour of Duty
programme.desc: The story of a single group of soldiers from the Welsh Guards who were deployed to Helmand Province, the frontline of the Afghanistan war, in 2009. The 10 soldiers share their unfiltered accounts, alongside testimony from their family members

programme.title: Best of Bloomberg Invest 2026
programme.desc: A recap of Bloomberg Invest New York, the flagship event in Bloomberg Live's 2026 series, featuring interviews with leaders in asset management, banking, private capital and wealth. Hosted by Dani Burger.

programme.title: The Deal with Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly
programme.desc: Intimate conversations with business titans and sports champions who reveal their investment philosophies, missed opportunities and more.

programme.title: Bloomberg Originals
programme.desc: Bold takes for curious minds on today's biggest topics. Covering stories you haven't seen and viewpoints you haven't heard

programme.title: Posthuman

programme.title: Marley & Me
programme.desc: Comedy drama based on a true story, starring Jennifer Aniston and Owen Wilson. Following their wedding, John Grogan buys his wife Jenny a cute, but irrepressible labrador puppy called Marley, little realising that their lives will never be quite the same again.

programme.title: Worst House on the Street
programme.desc: In Leicester, Lianne is currently living at her newly-wed brother's house, but is hoping to move herself and their father into their new home as soon as it's habitable. With just £20,000 to do all the work, siblings Stuart and Scarlette Douglas need all of their cost-saving tips and tricks to pull off this renovation

programme.title: Channel 4 News
programme.desc: Channel 4's flagship news programme. Including sport and weather

programme.title: Kevin McCloud's Listed Britain
programme.desc: Kevin looks at bold, modern places that challenge the idea of what heritage can be, and the places that can be the easiest to dismiss and the hardest to save. He steps inside Liverpool's Metropolitan Cathedral, which is flooded with coloured light from one of Britain's most spectacular stained-glass lanterns, and visits London Zoo's penguin pool, where the aquatic birds are treated to cutting-edge modernism

programme.title: Kevin McCloud's Classic Car Road Trips
programme.desc: Kevin explores Germany's Black Forest in a 1960s Mercedes SL. At Mercedes' museum in Stuttgart, he's let loose on a replica of the first car ever made. The innovation theme continues at the Weissenhof Estate where he explores a pioneering house by Le Corbusier. At Bad Wildbad, he watches a test flight of an electric, multi-rotor helicopter that promises sustainable affordable air travel in the very near future

programme.title: Stacey Dooley's Australia: Off the Beaten Track
programme.desc: Journalist and presenter Stacey Dooley explores Australia's most remote communities - a side of Australia few outsiders see. She begins on South Australia's Kangaroo Island, where locals have emerged stronger after devastating bushfires. Stacey explores the island's spectacular scenery and incredible wildlife up close and personal - and even plays a game of country football

programme.title: Formula 1 Sao Paulo Grand Prix Highlights
programme.desc: Lee McKenzie and Claire Williams present action from the 21st round of the season, which came from Interlagos. Lando Norris of McLaren was the victorious driver here last year, with Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli finishing in second place, and Red Bull's three-time winner of this race Max Verstappen completing the podium. Antonelli has been the dominant driver for much of this season, and with just three further rounds remaining, he will have been looking to close in on the title

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Kane Robinson and Jedaiah Bannerman. In a near-future London, social housing barely exists except for "The Kitchen", an estate on the outskirts of the city which is populated by a community of people who have nowhere to go and are threatened by new owners. Izi is a loner who works at a funeral home and keeps to himself, but that all changes when he befriends recently orphaned Benji.

programme.title: The F Ward
programme.desc: Ellie runs into trouble with the head of the OBGYN department. Anita makes Gloria do a training course after she receives a record number of HR complaints. Josh and Jimmy push the boundaries on their cover shift, leading to a showdown with Gloria, and sparks fly and hearts break when Lisa and Yosef host a house party and the interns relearn the cost of recklessness

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Italy v South Africa (Kick-off 11.40am). Jill Douglas presents all the action from both teams' opening match of the Northern Hemsiphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium in Turin. With analysis from John Barclay, Greig Laidlaw and Sean Fitzpatrick, commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie, and reports from Gabriel Clarke

programme.title: Nations Championship

With analysis from Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts

But that bad attitude comes back to haunt him after he dashes the hopes of his girlfriend's daughter - he's sentenced to work as a tooth fairy, and the tutu and wings are non-negotiable.

programme.desc: An extended edition of the irreverent panel show, hosted by Jimmy Carr. programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jack Whitehall and Roisin Conaty join host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson for more comic innuendos, unpredictable conundrums and unforgivable puns in the comedy panel show's version of the words-and-numbers quiz. Rob Beckett is with Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while comedian Joe Wilkinson is back to 'help' Rachel Riley with her mathematical sums and duties

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Uncut
programme.desc: An extended edition of the irreverent panel show, hosted by Jimmy Carr. Team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Jo Brand, Nick Helm, Jordan Stephens and Louis Walsh to answer questions based on opinion polls, finding out who best understands what is going on in Britain today

programme.title: Don't Spook the Bride
programme.desc: In a Halloween special, Sam wants a witchy wedding in the woods. Ezra has set her heart on a fairytale do. Will Sam's ghoulish gathering be a Halloween nightmare?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: The end is nigh for fantasy fan Evan as he plans to wage war on his wedding day. However, his emotional bride-to-be Zoe wants a low-key family affair. Will this noble groom make his bride feel like a queen, or will Evan's epic Game of Thrones-inspired plan be an epic fail?

programme.title: Property Brothers: Buying and Selling
programme.desc: In the fifth season, more couples put their homes in the bros' hands. Can Jonathan and Drew raise the roof off of dilapidated, draughty and dingy digs? The brothers take on helping Fran and Rocky with their tiny home. And while Jonathan gets to work, Drew house hunts in one of Nashville's most expensive neighbourhoods. But everything changes when Grandma and Grandpa step in. Will the renovation have a smooth run or hit a rocky patch?Short: Jonathan helps Fran and Rocky renovate their tiny home while Drew house hunts in one of Nashville's most expensive neighbourhoods. But everything changes when Grandma and Grandpa step in

programme.title: Property Brothers: Buying and Selling
programme.desc: In the fifth season, more couples put their homes in the bros' hands. Can Jonathan and Drew raise the roof off of dilapidated, draughty and dingy digs?In Nashville, Jonathan helps to spruce up the property when Kim and Tim's garden needs a trim. Drew wants to find their dream home, but can he manage the tricky challenge of finding more for less?

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Stacy Anderson, the brand president of global business Anytime Fitness, poses as a potential franchise owner to make sure all companies using the name are offering the same experience. She meets a gym manager, a personal trainer and a franchise owner to see if they company is fighting fit

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three couples from Leeds compete to host the best dinner party, beginning with construction manager Martin and his wife Amanda, who are determined to win. They are rivalled by competitive engaged couple Amy and Nico who impress with their entertainment and Hannah and Nick, who try to prove their doubters wrong by cooking duck to order

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Fifty-somethings Lesley and Roger, music teachers Emma and Chris, and teacher and ex-soldier Bonita and Tony take part in the culinary challenge in Leicester. Highlights include an international-themed evening inspired by the couple's love of luxury cruises and the youngest contestants desperate to prove they can serve up fine cuisine

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three couples from in and around Rugby, Warwickshire, compete in the challenge. Laid-back estate agent Michael and his partner Caroline cook a fine dining menu, but party queens Soroya and Jodie aren't impressed with the main. Expectations are high that Freddie and Raj will produce a fantastic menu, but Michael and Caroline are looking for cracks in their perfect relationship. On the final night, Soroya and Jodie are determined to show their guests what they're all about - but things fail to go according to plan

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to Mike & Nellie's Steakhouse in Oakhurst, New Jersey, where owner Mike Farber is mourning his father Nellie, who was also his business partner. Having been called in by the restaurateur's two daughters, Gordon faces the task of getting him to focus on his business, before tackling the bigger problem of rotting decor and a less-than-appealing menu

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef travels to Philadelphia to help failing Mexican restaurant Zocalo. Owners Greg and Mary Russell met and fell in love while they were working there, and the place held such sentimental importance to them they pooled their money and bought it. Now Gordon tries to turn things around before the floundering business ruins their marriage and tears their family apart

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay travels to Fremont, California, in an attempt to save a restaurant that is tearing the owners' marriage apart. Saki Kavouniaris took over Spin a Yarn in 1995 and began to turn it into a success, before marrying bartender Jennifer. When the business started to fail, the couple decided to splash out on refurbishments to recover their glory days, but their efforts have been futile and now their relationship is at stake

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to Charlie's Italian bistro in La Verne, southern California, where the owner's lack of business nous is putting her relatives' homes at risk, after her mother and sister put them up as collateral. To make matters worse, the restaurant's food is less than appetising and its long-serving chef seems to be incompetent

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay's next stop is Philadelphia, where family run restaurant Chiarella's is struggling to survive in an area full of thriving Italian eateries. Tommy and Dina Defino's marriage is on the verge of collapse and his sense of personal failure only adds to the troubles of their crisis-ridden business

programme.title: Taskmaster Bleeped
programme.desc: It's the grand final! By the end of this episode, the identity of the 22nd Taskmaster champion will be known and they will take their place among the pantheon of greats who know what it's like to touch, feel and even kiss the hallowed golden-head-on-a-plinth that looks almost nothing like Greg Davies. It's an episode full of answers to questions that people have been asking for years. What does Matt Lucas look like with a full head of ginger hair? How prodigiously can Richard Ayoade bounce across a room? Does Nina Conti know how to deliver a shot of adrenalin? And has Alex Horne got much leg hair? Once everyone has had fun puppeteering Alex, the final scores will be announced, and one deservedly smug competitor will walk away with the Taskmaster trophy tucked safely in an old carrier bag that they brought along just in case

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Reginald D Hunter and Aisling Bea join host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson for more comic innuendos, unpredictable conundrums and unforgivable puns in the comedy quiz. Holly Walsh is with Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while comedian Joe Wilkinson 'helps' Rachel Riley with her mathematical sums and duties

programme.title: Joe Lycett: I'm About to Lose Control and I Think Joe Lycett
programme.desc: In a gig recorded at the Hammersmith Apollo, London, Joe Lycett shares jokes, paintings and some of the pathetic trolling he's been up to, such as breaking into banks, selling art for £12.5million and taking on bronze medal-winning Olympians

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats: Best Bits
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr is joined by captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson for highlights from the latest series of the comedy panel show. A host of well-known faces make up the teams as they discuss the topical events that set the public's chins wagging

programme.title: The Creator
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring John David Washington. Huge leaps in robotics and machine learning lead to an artificial intelligence apparently choosing to detonate a nuclear bomb over Los Angeles. Now outlawed across much of the world, all remaining AI-powered bots have relocated to New Asia where US soldier Joshua Taylor is sent to find information about a formidable weapon being developed by the machines.

programme.title: The Artifice Girl
programme.desc: Special agents create a revolutionary AI system to catch internet child predators, but disaster looms when it develops quicker than intended. Sci-fi mystery, starring Tatum Matthews, Lance Henriksen, Sinda Nichols and David Girard

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
programme.desc: Mystery starring Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce. When a pioneering bombsight is developed during the Second World War for use against the Nazis, Sherlock Holmes tries to prevent it falling into the hands of his arch rival Professor Moriarty.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voice of James McAvoy. Santa's job of getting presents to all the children in just one night is an operation that requires military precision. But when a glitch in the system means that a little girl is not going to get her new bike, it falls to Santa's clumsy son Arthur to make sure she isn't disappointed.

programme.title: Tooth Fairy
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Dwayne Johnson and Ashley Judd. Ice-hockey player Derek Thompson is an abusive and aggressive thug when he's out on the rink, with a reputation for knocking out his opponent's teeth. But that bad attitude comes back to haunt him after he dashes the hopes of his girlfriend's daughter - he's sentenced to work as a tooth fairy, and the tutu and wings are non-negotiable.

programme.title: The Kid Who Would Be King
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Louis Ashbourne Serkis, Rebecca Ferguson and Patrick Stewart. Schoolboy Alex happens upon the ancient sword Excalibur, but in the process awakens the evil sorceress Morgana. With the help of his friends and the advice of wizard Merlin, Alex has just four days to save the world from Morgana's clutches.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Romantic sci-fi drama starring Emily Blunt and Matt Damon. A seemingly random series of events brings ambitious politician David Norris together with ballet dancer Elise Sellas, with whom he falls in love. But was their meeting down to chance, and are there now supernatural forces conspiring to keep them apart?

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Gary Oldman, Jason Clarke and Andy Serkis. With most of the human population wiped out, the world is now ruled by super-intelligent apes. But their chimp leader Caesar finds his loyalties divided when a small band of human survivors strike back.

programme.title: Downton Abbey

programme.title: Downton Abbey

Back at Downton, the servants hold the fort and unlikely later-life romances abound, while Bates takes drastic measures to clear Anna's name as she faces an uncertain future behind bars. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Resident clockmaker Steven Fletcher rescues a very special skeleton clock just in the nick of time. This Victorian antiquity has been in Nigel Burch's family for four generations. It was awarded in 1918 to his grandfather Ernest Sidney, who despite sustaining an injury in the First World War went to become a successful athlete. Now with Nigel's son Pete in training for the 2020 Paralympics, the time is right for Nigel to hand over the precious timepiece to the next generation.
Teddy bear repair pair Amanda and Julie have a huge job on their hands, bringing a giant bear back to his former glory. Owner Stefan wants to pass 'Big Ted' down to his ten-year-old daughter Jessica, but sadly this larger than life bear is a shadow of his former self, currently living out his days in a black bin liner with all the stuffing knocked out of him. Julie and Amanda soon run out of work space in the barn, so take Big Ted outside to start his transformation into a cuddly colossus.
And vintage radio restorer Mark Stuckey revives a much-loved transistor radio that holds very dear memories for its owner. Bought by Albert Thompson and his then-girlfriend Eileen in 1961, it provided the soundtrack to Albert and Eileen's courtship and to their long and happy marriage. Sadly, the radio broke down and stopped working two years to the day after Albert's beloved wife Eileen passed away. It will take the combined efforts of three of the Repair Shop's finest experts to bring it back to life.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Things are heating up in the Repair Shop forge as metalworker Dominic Chinea tackles one of the biggest challenges he's ever faced: a dilapidated old weather vane that once stood proudly on the roof of the village church in Gosport, Hampshire. Rusted and stubbornly non-functioning, the job requires Dom to call on all his considerable skills - from metal salvage to graphic design - before it can be reinstalled, to stand proudly once again in its Hampshire churchyard home.
Master saddler Suzie Fletcher enlists the help of teddy bear expert Julie Tatchell to fix an unusual leather rhino named Ralph. Poor old Ralph is missing his tail, has a baggy bottom and bears the scars of a tangle with the family cat. But despite his weathered appearance, he is a much-treasured gift and has huge sentimental value for his owner Claire.
And the Repair Shop's authority on all things clockwork, horologist Steve Fletcher, does some sterling work on a little racing car and amazes its owner with an unexpected addition.

programme.title: Blue Planet II

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys

His next stop is Crosby on the Merseyside coastline in Sefton, before making his way north to Blackpool, the last stop on this leg of his journey

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his journey across the vast and beautiful Morecambe Bay, where he joins one of the town's last shrimpers to find out how potted shrimp is made, From there, Michael makes his way to Arnside on the Furness Line, where he discovers a magnificently quirky 17th century garden, and across the Arnside viaduct, he reaches Cartmel and its 12th century priory and a Michelin-starred restaurant

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels though Cumbria, setting sail in a small craft on Lake Windermere with a lifelong devotee of Arthur Ransome's children's books Swallows and Amazons. At Barrow-in-Furness, Michael investigates the mountains of scrap left behind as iron ore was turned into ships, trains and railway tracks, and discovers researchers are exploring how slagbanks could contribute to reducing atmospheric carbon dioxide.

programme.title: Villages by the Sea
programme.desc: Ben Robinson discovers more about the quiet village of Ravenglass in the Lake District's National Park, which played a strategic role in the Roman empire. With the help of the Pennington family, whose ancestral home is Muncaster Castle, Ben is shown their latest Roman find, a unique stone slab with a Latin inscription that's been attributed to a Roman naval unit, Aelia Classica

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough travels to the Arctic and Antarctic to explore the wildernesses at Earth's poles, investigating the wildlife and geographical features found there. He begins by travelling to the North Pole, where two polar bears reveal a surprisingly tender side to their characters, before heading to the South Pole - 100 years after Roald Amundsen and Robert Falcon Scott first reached it

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: A polar bear hunts with her cubs, while the warmer weather of spring accelerates a process that will eventually see an area of ice the size of Australia disappear into the Arctic Ocean. A woolly bear caterpillar emerges from the snow after spending the winter frozen, and in Antarctica male Adelie penguins arrive to begin constructing nests in fierce storms as they try to attract mates

programme.title: Killer Women with Piers Morgan
programme.desc: Piers travels to Gadsden Correctional Facility near Tallahassee in Florida, where he hears the story of Ashley Humphrey. As a 20-year-old in 2003, she pumped eight bullets into barmaid Sandee Rozzo - a crime for which she is now serving 25 years. Piers tries to understand how she came to commit the crime, wondering whether she was persuaded by her domineering and abusive husband - who was being accused of rape by the victim - or if she is simply a cold-blooded killer who came up with the plan herself

programme.title: Killer Women with Piers Morgan
programme.desc: The broadcaster travels to Bedford Hills Correctional Facility in New York State to meet Sheila Davalloo, who has been convicted for murdering Anna Lisa Raymundo. However, in a bizarre twist to the story, Sheila has not yet started her 50-year sentence. First she must finish the 25 years she was given for the attempted murder of her husband. Sheila has remained silent about the killing for 14 years, so Piers tries to get her to finally open up, while also looking into why she wanted both of her victims out of the way

programme.title: One Born Every Minute
programme.desc: Childhood best friends Karra and Danny realise their deep friendship has helped them cope and given them a positive outlook on life as they await the arrival of their third child. programme.desc: Sam and Tony are called to a woman suffering excruciating stomach pain, but soon find themselves dealing with a sudden seizure. Stef and Lee treat an excitable six-year-old.

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: Paramedics collect a seriously injured man airlifted in from Wales, deal with a distressed pensioner who has taken a tumble, and treat a toddler struggling to breathe.

programme.title: The Supervet: Noel Fitzpatrick
programme.desc: Four-year-old pug and beagle cross Barney is brought into Fitzpatrick Referrals after being hit by a bus. The dog has lost 40 per cent of the bone in the damaged leg, so Noel creates an innovative two-tier treatment, involving an external ankle frame for support. Sisters Rosemary and Diane bring in their five-year-old basset hound Albert when they find he is suddenly unable to move his back legs, and 10-month-old Labrador cross Gylly receives treatment for lameness and an unusual bone deformity

programme.title: The Supervet: Noel Fitzpatrick
programme.desc: Golden retriever poodle-cross Suki's front legs have developed abnormally and now require urgent attention as the bones of her forearms are growing at different rates, so Noel decides that major surgery is required. Beloved elderly Labrador Raffa is nearly 11 and has become lame with constant pain in his front legs, and Noel discovers cartilage erosion in both elbows. Meanwhile, five-year-old dachshund Zizi is rushed in after suddenly losing the use of her back legs overnight, and an urgent MRI scan confirms that Zizi has suffered an exploded disc

programme.title: The Supervet: Noel Fitzpatrick
programme.desc: A couple bring their 13-month-old cocker spaniel puppy in for scheduled surgery for hip dysplasia which will require two separate full hip replacements. Elsewhere, two-year-old cat Jazz is rushed in by mum Sarah suffering from a smashed femur and shattered thorax after being hit by a car, and eight-year-old dachshund Olive is treated after suddenly losing the use of her back legs

programme.title: The Supervet: Noel Fitzpatrick
programme.desc: Noel diagnoses the joint condition osteochondritis dissecans in a hyperactive ridgeback named Loki, and discusses treatment options with his owners. Newfoundland Hugo is referred for his hip dysplasia, but Noel discovers issues with his elbow and knee joints, while Carol and Nigel bring their mischievous seven-month-old Havana kitten Zahra following a mysterious accident at home, which resulted in a broken leg

programme.title: The Supervet: Noel Fitzpatrick
programme.desc: An energetic one-year-old bull terrier puppy called Apple comes into the surgery with an ankle problem, and Noel hopes a custom-made, 3D-printed implant may give this beloved pet a new lease of life. He also treats a two-year-old Siamese cat with a broken leg, shattered pelvis and suspected spinal injury after being hit by a van, while four-year-old collie cross Rosco is tested for hip dysplasia

programme.title: Dog School
programme.desc: Bella the Newfoundland has her first daycare groom, but staff have to coax her out of the lake and into the shower, while Henry the Labrador's play is restricted because of his joints

programme.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
programme.desc: Pete helps train one of Dogs Trust's longest-staying residents and supports eleven Shih Tzus all rescued from the same household.

programme.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
programme.desc: Pete meets a litter of puppies known as the Potato Pups, who were found abandoned in a crisp box, and helps the staff fight to keep them alive.

programme.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
programme.desc: The team tackles a dramatic operation where a patient's heart is stopped and restarted. Zoe has a stent replaced in her ureter, which was damaged by her treatment for cancer.

programme.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
programme.desc: Trisha has an investigation of her womb to find out if she has cancer, Steve's varicose veins are stripped from his leg, and Dennis needs an operation to strengthen his eyelid.

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: Reality series following West Midlands paramedics. A woman has the worst nose bleed the ambulance crew have ever seen, and both a mum and her son need treatment.

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: The series concludes with a look at the ways human activity can impact on aquatic wildlife, including albatrosses unwittingly feeding their offspring plastic, mother dolphins with contaminated milk, and communications between animals being disrupted by noise. However, there are signs of hope, including the thriving Norwegian Spring-Spawning Herring, previously on the brink of extinction, and efforts to save endangered species like the whale shark and to preserve the eggs of giant leatherback turtles

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo returns to travel by train to more places around the British Isles, beginning by heading to the self-governing Isle of Man - a paradise for rail lovers. programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys

programme.title: Martin Clunes: A Man and His Dogs
programme.desc: Part one of two. The actor explores the ancient ancestry of domestic dogs and discovers why their relationship with humans has been so successful. Travelling across the globe, from dog shows in London to the wilderness of the Australian Outback, he unravels the links that have made man and beast inseparable for 15,000 years

programme.title: Martin Clunes: A Man and His Dogs
programme.desc: The actor concludes his two-part documentary with a look at man's relationship with his best friend. He considers how dogs' abilities have been harnessed to good effect in pursuits ranging from tracking and herding to assisting the police and disabled people. Martin also explores how selective breeding has damaged the health of many breeds, and concludes by asking what would happen if dogs simply walked away from the relationship

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of Australia

He also explores Phillip Island, one of Australia's favourite playgrounds, then heads south to King Island, in the blustery Bass Strait between Tasmania and mainland Australia. Martin completes his odyssey with a visit to see one of the region's most iconic creatures, the Tasmanian Devil

programme.title: David Jason's Great British Inventions

programme.title: Indian Ocean with Simon Reeve
