Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Couples Weekend
programme.desc: Four adults navigate deception and desire when a fallen tree on New Year's Eve triggers a chain of events that challenges their relationships and the lies they tell themselves and each other. Writer/director Nora Kirkpatrick's comedy drama, starring Alexandra Daddario and Daveed Diggs

programme.title: Racewalkers
programme.desc: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural talent for the sport as they challenge the sport's top competitor. Comedy, directed by and starring Kevin Claydon and Phil Moniz

programme.title: Forbidden Fruits
programme.desc: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch coven with co-workers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin challenges their sisterhood, forcing the trio to confront their inner darkness. As tensions rise and the coven's secrets threaten to spill, they must face their fears or all meet a violent end. Comedy horror, starring Lili Reinhart

programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: Rumble in the Bronx
programme.desc: Martial arts crime drama starring Jackie Chan. A Hong Kong policeman visiting New York for the wedding of a relative becomes involved in a battle against a gang that's conducting a campaign of terror in the Bronx.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival

programme.title: Murder by Decree
programme.desc: Period detective drama starring Christopher Plummer and James Mason. When a brutal killer begins murdering London prostitutes, Scotland Yard takes the unusual approach of employing a psychic to help them with their investigations. But Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson are soon on the case.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: The Big Heat
programme.desc: Film noir starring Glenn Ford, Gloria Grahame and Lee Marvin. When tough detective Dave Bannion is assigned to investigate a colleague's suicide, he is sceptical about the reasons given for his death. Forced to work under cover, he discovers the existence of a suicide note that implicates a brutal Mob boss.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson and Kim Basinger. In the rotten heart of Gotham City, wrongdoers face a new nemesis: a caped crusader cracking down on crime. Photojournalist Vicki Vale's investigations take her to a party given by easy-going millionaire playboy Bruce Wayne. Meanwhile, dapper mobster Jack Napier becomes a fall guy for his criminal kingpin boss and undergoes a terrible transformation, emerging as a twisted villain destined to pose a deadly threat to Vicki and the mysterious Batman.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: Sequel to the 1989 action fantasy Batman, starring Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Michelle Pfeiffer. The Caped Crusader returns to action when Gotham City is threatened by corrupt tycoon Max Shreck and the vengeful Penguin. As he battles the forces of crime, Batman discovers a deadly new foe in the shape of feline vigilante, Catwoman.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Kevin Costner, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Alan Rickman and Morgan Freeman. After escaping from prison in the Holy Land, Robin of Locksley and his friend Azeem return to England, where they discover Robin's father murdered and King Richard exiled. When they meet a band of thieves in the woods, they join forces to try to oust the wicked Sheriff of Nottingham.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
programme.desc: Action thriller sequel starring Lucas Black. To avoid jail for illegal street racing, a bad-boy teenager is sent to Japan to stay with his estranged father. However, his discovery of drifting, a new style of racing reliant on the use of oversteering, soon gets him into more trouble.

programme.title: Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller in which Vin Diesel and Paul Walker, the stars of the first film in the street-racing franchise, team up again. Criminal Dominic Toretto returns to LA to avenge the murder of one of his friends by a drug kingpin, bringing him face to face with an old rival - FBI agent Brian O'Conner.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

Historical action adventure starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey and David Wenham. When the fiercely ambitious King Xerxes of Persia plans to invade Greece, King Leonidas mobilises his personal bodyguard of 300 Spartan warriors to defend the pass at Thermopylae.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the 1969 British caper movie, starring Mark Wahlberg and Edward Norton. A criminal gang run by Charlie Croker (Wahlberg) and veteran thief John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) pulls off an audacious gold bullion robbery in Venice, only for colleague Steve (Edward Norton) to run off with the loot, leaving Bridger dead. Finally tracking Steve down to LA, Croker enlists the help of Bridger's safecracking daughter Stella (Charlize Theron) to get even in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker and Vin Diesel. When illegal street racer Dominic Toretto is suspected of being the mastermind behind a series of truck hijacks, undercover police officer Brian O'Conner is sent to infiltrate his gang. But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker. Disgraced cop Brian O'Conner is given the chance to redeem himself by going under cover to entrap a powerful Miami drugs baron.

programme.title: Cool Hand Luke
programme.desc: Prison drama starring Paul Newman and George Kennedy. After being sentenced to two years on a chain gang, Luke Jackson is faced with the unrelenting demands of the camp's daily routine. However, his resilience quickly antagonises the gang boss.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Thriller starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn and Chase Infiniti. Years after the collapse of his political revolutionary group, Bob Ferguson lives in paranoid seclusion with his teenage daughter, Willa. But the merciless Colonel Lockjaw, a one-time target of Bob's group, has been hunting its members ever since, and has unfinished business with Bob.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: Oscar-winning biographical drama starring Julia Roberts. When she loses a lawsuit following a car accident, unemployed single mother Erin Brockovich browbeats her lawyer, Ed Masry, into giving her a job. Soon she discovers that a power company has been dumping toxic waste and poisoning the residents of a small town. Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

programme.title: The Bodyguard
programme.desc: Romantic thriller starring Kevin Costner and Whitney Houston. Bodyguard and former secret serviceman Frank Farmer, still haunted by the assassination attempt on President Reagan, is asked to safeguard superstar singer and actress Rachel Marron who has been receiving death threats. But when Farmer visits Marron's luxurious home he is met with resentment from the singer and those around her.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: After his son is killed, a father abducts the child responsible, hell-bent on revenge. Writer/Director Evan Ari Kelman's thriller, starring Hamish Linklater, Tramell Tillman and Brittany Snow

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime drama starring Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Andy Garcia and Robert De Niro. Determined young federal agent Eliot Ness leads a tough team of investigators in a dangerous mission to end Al Capone's violent reign of terror in Prohibition-era Chicago.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Audrey Tautou. When the victim of a ritualised killing is discovered at the Louvre, French cryptographer Sophie Neveu and Harvard professor Robert Langdon are called in to try to identify strange symbols cut into the body. They become embroiled in a deadly conspiracy that has shattering ramifications for Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on Dan Brown's forerunner to The Da Vinci Code, starring Tom Hanks and Ayelet Zurer. With the election of a new pope imminent, the Illuminati kidnap the four leading contenders and issue a coded message that they will murder the men and blow up the Vatican. Catholic leaders turn to Harvard symbolist Robert Langdon, who must put his uneasy relationship with the church hierarchy aside in an effort to crack the code and save the men's lives.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestseller by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Felicity Jones. Renowned symbologist Dr Robert Langdon wakes up in a Florence hospital with a head injury and no memory of the previous 48 hours. However, he soon finds himself hunted and forced to undertake a globe-trotting race against time to prevent the release of a deadly virus capable of killing half the world's population.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs. Four teenage boys pledge to lose their virginity before their high-school prom, but their efforts have hilarious and outrageous consequences.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
programme.desc: Prequel to the Jim Carrey/Jeff Daniels comedy Dumb and Dumber, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson. Dumbo duo Lloyd and Harry meet in their teens and inadvertently foil a fund-embezzling plot by their high-school principal.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy featuring the music of Abba, and starring Meryl Streep, Colin Firth and Pierce Brosnan. On an idyllic Greek island, young Sophie Sheridan prepares to marry the man of her dreams. But a problem looks set to blight the big day as the bride doesn't know who her father is. So Sophie sends out invitations to three men who might fit the bill, hoping to solve the riddle once her guests arrive.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jonah Hill and Michael Cera as Seth and Evan, two boys bonded by their lack of popularity. When the pair finally get invited to a party they embark on a quest to procure alcohol in the hope that it will not only lay to rest their geeky reputation but also improve their chances with the opposite sex.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs. Four teenage boys pledge to lose their virginity before their high-school prom, but their efforts have hilarious and outrageous consequences.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: American Pie: The Wedding
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan. After pursuing each other through two movies, Jim and Michelle finally decide to tie the knot, but their friends' plans for a bachelor party almost derail the forthcoming nuptials.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Calm with Horses
programme.desc: Douglas 'Arm' Armstrong has become a feared enforcer for the drug-dealing Devers family, while also trying to be a good father. Torn between these two families, Arm's loyalties are tested when he is asked to kill for the first time. Crime drama, starring Cosmo Jarvis, Barry Keoghan and Niamh Algar

programme.title: Shayda
programme.desc: Drama starring Zar Amir Ebrahimi. After fleeing her abusive husband, an Iranian woman living in Australia spends two weeks living in a woman's shelter with her young daughter.

programme.title: LumoTV: World War II: Unheard Memories
The Shepherd of the Hills
programme.desc: Adventure starring John Wayne and Betty Field. Matt Matthews, an Ozark Mountains moonshiner, has vowed since boyhood to kill a man he has never seen - his own father, who seemingly deserted Matt's mother and left her to die. It's an all-consuming quest that's preventing him from marrying his sweetheart, Sammy Lane.

programme.title: The True Story of Jesse James
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Wagner and Jeffrey Hunter. Infamous outlaw Jesse James and his gang are cornered in a swamp following a failed bank raid. As James prepares to shoot his way to freedom, the story of his life of violence and crime is told by his family and loved ones.

programme.title: The Mouse That Roared
programme.desc: Comedy starring Peter Sellers and Jean Seberg. A tiny European country is facing bankruptcy because its chief export - a very fine wine - is being undercut by an American company. The Prime Minister decrees that they must declare war on the USA, surrender and enjoy the benefits from their conquerors.

programme.title: Jubal
programme.desc: Western drama starring Glenn Ford and Ernest Borgnine. Drifter Jubal Troop's arrival at Shep Horgan's cattle ranch causes tension when he attracts advances from Horgan's young wife.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring Tessa Thompson and Chris Hemsworth. Agent M, an eager rookie in the secret MIB organiation, is sent to the London office where she's partnered with laid-back Agent H. When their first assignment together ends in disaster, M begins to suspect a mole must have infiltrated the agency. But who could it be - and is her partner to be trusted?

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring Woody Harrelson and Andy Serkis. In the third instalment of the rebooted franchise, ape leader Caesar embarks on a quest for revenge after the crazed Colonel McCullough kills Caesar's family in a bid to assassinate him.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
Love Monster and his teammate Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny are excited to be entering the Invent Something New Day contest at the recycling shed. The challenge is to take something old that doesn't work anymore and make something new. The competition judge, Elder Chick, reveals that the winner will be awarded the Invent Something New Day trophy. She sets a quirky timer, and the competition begins!
Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny look through the materials in the shed and try and come up with a winning idea. They each come up with ideas, but neither are good enough. Just then, Elder Chick tells them that they only have half the time left to finish their inventions. Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny sigh and collapse onto a sofa, but they are bounced back up by some exposed springs. That gives them both an idea!
Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny wants to make a self-boinging-pogo-stick, but Love Monster wants to make a chocolate-shake-maker. They only have enough time left to make one, so they decide to split up and make their own inventions. Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny struggle to make their inventions work on their own. With time running out, Love Monster speaks to Book Cub, who tells him that sometimes things that don't seem to go together... do. Love Monster is struck by this as he looks around and sees the other teams helping each other finish their inventions in contrast with Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny, who is still struggling with hers.
Love Monster and Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny agree to put their two ideas together, and they create the choc-to-pogo just in time. Elder Chick awards the teammates the trophy! Sometimes two heads and two tails really are better than one!

Thairis air an t-sreath, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas mu charaidean, an dachaigh, an teaghlach, obair agus an aimsir am measg gu leòr eile ann an dòigh a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir ann an dramathan goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn luchd-ionnsachaidh èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr agus cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh, agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba is e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha.
Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne: www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan a tha ri fhaighinn air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the first steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, family, home, work and weather.
We meet diligent learners who have embraced speaking Gaelic, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. The intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway revisits scenic treks in mid-Wales. The first walk he re-discovers is in the foothills of the Cambrian mountains where he explores the Hafod estate - a 200-year-old tourist playground of spectacular woods, waterfalls and riverside trails. Next, he recalls a stroll on the border in Presteigne with a young man who walked the entire 1,100-mile perimeter of Wales in aid of Alzheimer's. Finally, Derek travels to the Elan Valley in Powys for a seven-mile circular walk, punctuated by incredible feats of engineering - dams. He hears how the famous Dam-busters' bouncing bombs were tested there

programme.desc: Sports comedy starring Vince Vaughn and Ben Stiller. Peter La Fleur is the owner of Average Joe's, a run-down gym that's short of cash and in danger of being taken over by hi-tech rivals Globo Gym. In desperation, La Fleur and his misfit friends form a dodgeball team in a bid to reach a tournament in Las Vegas, where the grand prize stands at a cool $50,000.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure based on a story by Hans Christian Andersen, featuring the voices of Jodi Benson and René Auberjonois. programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: Classic animated romantic fantasy from Disney, based on the popular children's story by Charles Perrault. The beautiful Cinderella endures a life of hardship with her malicious sisters and stepmother. But a visit from her fairy godmother could be set to change the downtrodden girl's fortunes.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: Animated science-fiction adventure based on Robert Louis Stevenson's classic novel, Treasure Island. When a pirate treasure map falls into the hands of young tearaway Jim Hawkins, he is determined to find the fabled loot. Joining a space galleon as a cabin boy, he sets off on an intergalactic voyage of discovery, under the watchful eye of mysterious cyborg cook John Silver.

Her refusal to deal with the truth comes to a head when Gordon finds a dead mouse in the doorway, prompting him to step up his efforts to change her ways

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Cats and dogs face off as furry frenemies. Plus, porch problems, and mum mayhem

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: During a trip to Palm Springs, Will and Carlton are arrested after being mistaken for car thieves, so they stage a media stunt in a bid to get out of jail. Comedy, starring Will Smith and Alfonso Ribeiro

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will surprises everyone with an apparent attempt to better himself by joining the school poetry club, but he has an ulterior motive. Starring Will Smith

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart joins forces with Donny, a new pupil at Springfield Elementary School who has a penchant for trouble-making - only to discover he is actually a spy acting on behalf of Principal Skinner. With the guest voice of Topher Grace (That '70s Show)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart and Lisa play an ill-advised cliff-top prank that leaves them convinced they have killed Martin. Meanwhile, Marge hires a TV crew to keep a constant watch over Homer so that she can be sure he is sticking to his diet

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The family takes in depressed country singer Lurleen Lumpkin, who is on the run from the Springfield authorities for not paying her taxes. Marge tries to help by tracking down the fugitive's deadbeat father, but he responds by stealing one of his daughter's songs and selling it. With the guest voices of Beverly D'Angelo and the Dixie Chicks

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart joins the 4-H youth movement and saves the life of a sickly calf, but makes the mistake of giving it to a farm girl named Mary. Unfortunately, her father Cletus thinks it constitutes a marriage proposal, and starts making hurried arrangements. With the voice of Zooey Deschanel

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Uncle Marvin reveals he has become a stockbroker and convinces Barry and his friends to invest their money with him. Beverly invites 50 people over for a Thanksgiving 'potluck' dinner instead of cooking for the family

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: When Murray insists that a reluctant Adam must have driving lessons, the family learns something new about Pops in the process. Erica's grumpy nature means she has a hard time making friends at college and she turns down an invitation to a toga party, but when Barry visits her for the weekend, he quickly thrives on the college social scene

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Dunphys and Manny are on their way back from breakfast at the pancake house when Phil is forced to swerve out of the way of an oncoming truck, a brush with death that prompts them all to re-evaulate their lives. Comedy, starring Ty Burrell

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Claire confronts neighbours from hell Ronnie and Amber about the eyesore of a boat on their front lawn - and when they refuse to move it, Phil has no alternative but to call in the big guns - dad Frank and a few of his retired pals. Meanwhile, Cam takes Lily to clown school

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil takes it hard when Luke gives him the 'teenage cold shoulder' - a day he always knew was coming - so he goes in search of a stand-in son. A dilemma presents itself for Jay when Gloria suspects Joe is allergic to Stella, while Mitchell does some freelance legal work for Claire, an experience he finds rather enlightening

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Valentine's Day arrives, which for the Dunphys means their chance to dress up and romance each other as their once-a-year role-play characters Clive and Juliana - although Claire begins to worry that Phil prefers her like this. Meanwhile, Jay's romantic plans hit a snag in the sassy form of Gloria's sister Sonia, who ends up trying to seduce him, and wires are crossed when Mitch and Cam find themselves in a sticky situation with pal Anders

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The family sees a different side to Grampa when he revisits his days as Gorgeous Godfrey - the most feared and villainous TV wrestler of all time. Mr Burns reveals he was a huge fan and persuades the old man to put on his spandex suit and return to the ring for one last fight

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Substitute teacher Mrs Cantwell (Tina Fey) takes an instant dislike to Lisa, and vows to give the youngster extra credit if she can figure out why. Meanwhile, Flanders is plagued with guilt after punching Homer. Featuring the guest voice of author Richard Dawkins

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Mr Burns attempts to fulfil his lifelong ambition of becoming a superhero and take down a rogues' gallery of familiar faces, but devoted sidekick Smithers secretly intervenes after noticing his boss isn't quite up to the challenge. Lisa steps in as Bart's attorney when he is falsely accused of pulling an Easter prank

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer is recruited to be a church deacon by the trendy new reverend - but when he starts to embrace the faith a little too seriously, Bart asks Flanders to help him track down their former pastor, the Rev Lovejoy. Meanwhile, the dry cleaners mistakenly swap Marge's wedding dress for one of Krusty's clown costumes. With the guest voice of Edward Norton

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: While the Keane family feud, Caleb's health takes a turn for the worse, and Vicky is reminded why it's important to get better. Elsewhere, a resident is threatened into silence

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Janine has big plans for a district-wide careers day and Ava is suddenly acting suspiciously professional. Spoof documentary starring Quinta Brunson

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Philip becomes worried when Will is picked to be a lucky charm by one of his most important clients

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: When Will complains black history is not taught at school, Vivian takes the job of teacher. Comedy, guest starring Dave Florek, with Will Smith and James Avery

programme.title: Made in Chelsea
programme.desc: Chuggs can't get Rosie out of his head since she's burst back into his life but Zeyno is tired of having to explain why she thinks he should leave her in the past. Freddy's forced to make a confession when word of a late-night afters reaches Beks. Jazz finds herself on good terms with Inga and Maali tries to get some closure through a conversation with Sam Prince

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: Something unprecedented happens in the First Dates restaurant tonight. When stunning 25-year-old Sasha is stood up, an unexpected knight in shining armour is waiting in the wings - waiter Sam. Meanwhile, 38-year-old sales manager Scott, who is looking for someone to mend his broken heart after the failure of an eight-year relationship, meets 28-year-old PA Victoria, and 55-year-old receptionist Debbie has her first date with a woman, in the shape of 59-year-old divorced security guard Ann

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Gary Oldman, Jason Clarke and Andy Serkis. With most of the human population wiped out, the world is now ruled by super-intelligent apes. But their chimp leader Caesar finds his loyalties divided when a small band of human survivors strike back.

programme.title: Calm with Horses
programme.desc: Douglas 'Arm' Armstrong has become a feared enforcer for the drug-dealing Devers family, while also trying to be a good father. Torn between these two families, Arm's loyalties are tested when he is asked to kill for the first time. Crime drama, starring Cosmo Jarvis, Barry Keoghan and Niamh Algar

programme.title: Shayda
programme.desc: Drama starring Zar Amir Ebrahimi. After fleeing her abusive husband, an Iranian woman living in Australia spends two weeks living in a woman's shelter with her young daughter.

programme.title: LumoTV: World War II: Unheard Memories
The Shepherd of the Hills
programme.desc: Adventure starring John Wayne and Betty Field. Matt Matthews, an Ozark Mountains moonshiner, has vowed since boyhood to kill a man he has never seen - his own father, who seemingly deserted Matt's mother and left her to die. It's an all-consuming quest that's preventing him from marrying his sweetheart, Sammy Lane.

programme.title: The True Story of Jesse James
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Wagner and Jeffrey Hunter. Infamous outlaw Jesse James and his gang are cornered in a swamp following a failed bank raid. As James prepares to shoot his way to freedom, the story of his life of violence and crime is told by his family and loved ones.

programme.title: The Mouse That Roared
programme.desc: Comedy starring Peter Sellers and Jean Seberg. A tiny European country is facing bankruptcy because its chief export - a very fine wine - is being undercut by an American company. The Prime Minister decrees that they must declare war on the USA, surrender and enjoy the benefits from their conquerors.

programme.title: Jubal
programme.desc: Western drama starring Glenn Ford and Ernest Borgnine. Drifter Jubal Troop's arrival at Shep Horgan's cattle ranch causes tension when he attracts advances from Horgan's young wife.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring Tessa Thompson and Chris Hemsworth. Agent M, an eager rookie in the secret MIB organiation, is sent to the London office where she's partnered with laid-back Agent H. When their first assignment together ends in disaster, M begins to suspect a mole must have infiltrated the agency. But who could it be - and is her partner to be trusted?

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring Woody Harrelson and Andy Serkis. In the third instalment of the rebooted franchise, ape leader Caesar embarks on a quest for revenge after the crazed Colonel McCullough kills Caesar's family in a bid to assassinate him.

programme.title: Buddy vs Christmas
programme.desc: Buddy competes against animatronic expert Lou Nasti. Judges Jason Chatfield and Courtney Quinn decide whose piece tells the best Christmas story.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Resident clockmaker Steven Fletcher rescues a very special skeleton clock just in the nick of time. This Victorian antiquity has been in Nigel Burch's family for four generations. It was awarded in 1918 to his grandfather Ernest Sidney, who despite sustaining an injury in the First World War went to become a successful athlete. Now with Nigel's son Pete in training for the 2020 Paralympics, the time is right for Nigel to hand over the precious timepiece to the next generation.
Teddy bear repair pair Amanda and Julie have a huge job on their hands, bringing a giant bear back to his former glory. Owner Stefan wants to pass 'Big Ted' down to his ten-year-old daughter Jessica, but sadly this larger than life bear is a shadow of his former self, currently living out his days in a black bin liner with all the stuffing knocked out of him. Julie and Amanda soon run out of work space in the barn, so take Big Ted outside to start his transformation into a cuddly colossus.
And vintage radio restorer Mark Stuckey revives a much-loved transistor radio that holds very dear memories for its owner. Bought by Albert Thompson and his then-girlfriend Eileen in 1961, it provided the soundtrack to Albert and Eileen's courtship and to their long and happy marriage. Sadly, the radio broke down and stopped working two years to the day after Albert's beloved wife Eileen passed away. It will take the combined efforts of three of the Repair Shop's finest experts to bring it back to life.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Things are heating up in the Repair Shop forge as metalworker Dominic Chinea tackles one of the biggest challenges he's ever faced: a dilapidated old weather vane that once stood proudly on the roof of the village church in Gosport, Hampshire. Rusted and stubbornly non-functioning, the job requires Dom to call on all his considerable skills - from metal salvage to graphic design - before it can be reinstalled, to stand proudly once again in its Hampshire churchyard home.
Master saddler Suzie Fletcher enlists the help of teddy bear expert Julie Tatchell to fix an unusual leather rhino named Ralph. Poor old Ralph is missing his tail, has a baggy bottom and bears the scars of a tangle with the family cat. But despite his weathered appearance, he is a much-treasured gift and has huge sentimental value for his owner Claire.
And the Repair Shop's authority on all things clockwork, horologist Steve Fletcher, does some sterling work on a little racing car and amazes its owner with an unexpected addition.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: The chef heads to Berlin, where history and the avant garde dwell side by side. A city that once made history with its divisive wall and Checkpoint Charlie now teems with an overwhelming array of innovative chefs offering delicious seasonal creations, such as pureed sunflower seeds, Jerusalem artichoke flans and crushed frozen pine nuts. Loved by the likes of Greta Garbo, Charlie Chaplin and Auguste Escoffier there's still a cornucopia of choice for those with a more traditional temperament with eisbein, meatballs and sausages topping every menu in the German capital

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: The chef visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to comfort dishes such as tafelspitz and goulash, and which gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes - the Wiener schnitzel. Rick learns the essential etiquette to the Austrian capital's coffee house culture and indulges in its sweet tooth by enjoying a plate or two of apple strudel and Sacher torte. He also finds time to enjoy the traditional music of the country, typically Mozart and Strauss

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers examine the history behind some of the nation's most famous dishes, beginning by exploring how the monarchy has influenced British cuisine. The duo also prepare a classic coronation chicken, and a beef dish named after Prince Albert, and food historian Ivan Day whips up a meal using a cookbook from the time of James II

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Built nearly a century before the British canal system, the Canal du Midi in the south of France has been designated a world heritage site. Timothy West and Prunella Scales explore a picturesque stretch, as is it meanders toward the Mediterranean. They visit the town of Beziers and the Malpas Tunnel - Europe's first navigable canal tunnel - and taste the delights of lamb's brain fritters, as well as brandy that is almost 200 years old

programme.title: Top Gear

programme.title: How Britain Worked
programme.desc: Engineering enthusiast Guy Martin and the team repair the water turbine needed to power an old saw mill in Wensleydale, North Yorkshire. He then ropes in a carpenter friend to help fell a tree and transport it to the building on a steam traction engine, before using the cut wood to make a replica of the first pedal-powered bicycle. Along the way, Guy learns about the lives of factory workers during the Industrial Revolution and how child apprentices were often little more than slave labour

programme.title: Berlin Wall: The Night the Iron Curtain Closed
programme.desc: Documentary focusing on the events of the night of August 13, 1961, when the border was closed, dividing the people of east and west Berlin. programme.title: Tropic of Cancer with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon witnesses the effect of extreme poverty on the people of Bangladesh, where children are put to work for as little as 30 pence a day. His journey down the River Padma shows the threat of climate change on the densely populated country as melting Himalayan ice prompts the collapse of its banks, and introduces him to the national sport of Kabbadi, from which he escapes with only minor injuries. He then crosses the border to Burma to begin the most dangerous leg of his trip

programme.title: Simon Reeve's South America
programme.desc: Simon starts his travels through Brazil in one of the remotest regions of the Amazon with the Waiapi people, who cling on to their traditional way of life, which is under threat from logging and mining interests. In Manaus, the city at the heart of the Amazon, he visits a neglected indigenous neighbourhood and meets a nurse who was the only source of healthcare during the pandemic. Simon ends this leg of his journey on the west coast in the city of Rio de Janeiro, where the government has built a hi-tech control room to monitor all parts of the city for potential disasters such as floods

programme.title: Sacred Rivers with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: The adventurer returns with a series that takes him around the world to areas that cannot be fully appreciated without considering the vast influence of their rivers, and he's going to explain how those sacred rivers don't just simply flow through countries - they define them. Simon begins at the source of the world's longest river, the Nile, and follows it out to sea, taking him from the Ethiopian highlands, through the desert of Sudan and then Egypt, right to the Mediterranean Sea. He also explains how the Nile has forged some of our earliest civilisations and influenced religions. However, the stability of the region looks uncertain, given that populations along its banks are growing, and Nile countries are demanding greater shares of the sacred waters

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
A former butcher brings his defunct sausage-making machine to the barn for Dominic Chinea, the resident metal work expert. It was once an essential bit of kit in owner Marcus Harding's dad's butcher's shop. A teenage Marcus was regularly tasked with sausage filling and became a dab hand. However when the shop closed, the machine was banished to the shed, where dust and rust has brought it to a grinding halt. This is a first for Dom and he's eager to roll up his sleeves and give the vintage machine a total overhaul. The rusted internal parts are too delicate for sandblasting so Dom comes up with a scientific solution, using an electrolysis machine. Once reassembled and given a new lick of paint this contraption is put to the test, when Marcus shares his family recipe and it's bangers for the Repair Shop team lunch!
Mary Murphy from Stafford arrives with a unique and fragile historical archive. It is in desperate need of expert intervention by bookbinder Chris Shaw. This crumbling Edwardian album is full of treasured family postcards sent by Mary's grandma to her sisters. Each precious card documents the young woman's day-to-day life and adventures and is treasured by Mary's family. Chris works meticulously by hand to display each of the cards in windowed pages and incorporates the original album covers with a sturdy new spine. Mary and her sister are over the moon with the results.
And silversmith Brenton West transforms a cherished family heirloom that was a wedding gift over half a century ago. The hot water urn, known as a samovar, was one of the few belongings that accompanied Nawzad and Karen when they fled Iraq with their young family. Brenton transforms the dented, tarnished urn and gets it back in action.

programme.desc: Things in the shop get lit when Corey checks out a Jason Aldean neon light. Rick has a hoot when he checks out a ceramic owl vase 'made' by Pablo Picasso, while a poster from the Beatles' Yellow Submarine movie lands on the counter

programme.title: Storage Wars: Texas
programme.desc: The buyers make some risky bids when they attend an auction at Fort Worth

programme.title: Storage Wars: Texas
programme.desc: The auction takes place in Lancaster, Texas - a spot on Bonnie and Clyde's 1934 robbery spree. Rick and Bubba seek to stock up for a huge furniture sale. Moe, back from a Hawaii vacation, buys a risky locker, running afoul of Mary. Jenny Grumbles, joined by her mother, finds something in a furniture locker that leaves her hanging, while Victor seems more interested in Jenny's mother than the auction. With one team aiming for a five figure profit, and another just happy to get out in one piece, it's boom or bust once more in this Old West town

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Mary makes an early start at an auction in Upland, while Dan and Laura try to make life difficult for their rivals

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Dave surprises his rivals by revealing a lighter side to his nature, and Jarrod and Brandi return to the site of a past triumph

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Ten discoveries and breakthroughs that challenge traditional beliefs about human history. They include a lost city hidden in the Andes, mysterious metal spheres that are not of this world and a sunken city that is said to be the home of the gods

programme.title: Alien Files: Unsealed
programme.desc: Experts unseal the truth about the potential aliens living and working among us. Who has come in peace? And who has a more sinister motive in mind?

programme.title: Alien Files: Unsealed
programme.desc: Experts investigate the mystery of the Solway Firth Spaceman - a spacesuit-clad figure who strangely appeared in a photograph taken in Cumbria.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: Mike and Frank find a mysterious wooden box on a large property, but cannot identify what it is. Fortunately, an appraiser is on hand to help them out

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: David Dickinson helps members of the public in St Albans, Hertfordshire, sort the treasures from their trash, offering them the chance to put items up for auction or accept a cash sum. Simon Schneider learns about Mughal jewellery, Ian Towning has a date with 'The Green Lady', and Karen Dalmeny tries to get to the bottom of an obscure Victorian stick

programme.title: The Great British Treasure Hunt
programme.desc: Henry Cole takes five teams of intrepid metal detectorists to Somerleyton in Suffolk for round three of the series. As the teams compete to be crowned detectorists of the year, they unearth rare artefacts and ancient coins

programme.title: Weird Britain
programme.desc: Andy McGrath visits places with an unusual story to tell

programme.title: Mission Unexplained
programme.desc: Reports of odd phenomena, witnessed over the years. A staff sergeant remembers an encounter with a shadowy figure with long dark hair during an exercise. She attacked him, then disappeared. US Marine James Gelston recalls hearing horrifying screams in one of deposed Iraq leader Saddam Hussein's former torture houses, unaware of their source to this day

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Anjelica Huston and Raul Julia. The arrival of baby Pubert leads to some "deadly" games in the Addams household as the jealous Wednesday and Pugsley try to dispose of their new sibling. Morticia and Gomez hire Debbie as a nanny for the new arrival, and Debbie soon attracts the amorous attentions of Uncle Fester. But the nanny's motives prove to be even more sinister than the Addams clan itself.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Kung fu prodigy Li Fong moves to New York City with his mother and befriends his classmate, Mia. But Connor Day, a local karate champion, provokes Li and publicly humiliates him. Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure based on the popular TV series. Tommy Pickles is feeling forced out by his new baby brother who just makes too much noise. But when Tommy hatches a plan to return his sibling to the hospital, it leads to some unexpected adventures.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bruce Willis and Chrissie Hynde. Young Tommy Pickles gets the opportunity to meet his nature-documentary hero Sir Nigel Thornberry, after his family vacation goes awry. Stranded on a desert island, the baby and his pals think they're alone, until they encounter the Thornberry clan filming their latest animal epic.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter. As the annual Giant Vegetable Competition approaches, enterprising Wallace and Gromit cash in with their humane pest-control outfit, "Anti-Pesto". But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure featuring the voices of Nicole Kidman, Elijah Wood and Robin Williams. In the freezing Antarctic, Emperor penguins find their soul mate through their own unique "heart song". Unfortunately for young bird Mumble, he can't sing a note, but he can tap dance brilliantly. Social rejection soon follows, leading his "happy feet" to be blamed for a colony-threatening fish famine. Determined to prove his worth, Mumble heads off on a perilous journey to discover the truth about what has happened to the fish stocks.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Elijah Wood. Mumble and his son Erik must rescue their friends and family in the aftermath of a natural disaster.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure featuring the voices of Justin Timberlake and Anna Kendrick. The happy land of trolls comes under threat from the Bergens, their miserable, giant neighbours who have developed a taste for trolls. When their kinfolk are kidnapped, bickering trolls Branch and Princess Poppy set out to free them before they're served up for dinner.

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Woody Allen, Sharon Stone, Sylvester Stallone and Gene Hackman. In an ant hill that contains millions of inhabitants, neurotic worker ant Z has trouble conforming to the regimented way of life. But his mundane existence is changed for ever when he meets the beautiful Princess Bala and becomes involved in the sinister plans of power-mad General Mandible.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Alec Baldwin. When a seven-year-old boy discovers that his baby brother is a spy on a secret mission, he joins forces with his suit-wearing, briefcase-carrying sibling to defeat an evil businessman.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jonah Hill and Michael Cera as Seth and Evan, two boys bonded by their lack of popularity. When the pair finally get invited to a party they embark on a quest to procure alcohol in the hope that it will not only lay to rest their geeky reputation but also improve their chances with the opposite sex.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: National Security
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Martin Lawrence and Steve Zahn. A string of misunderstandings lead to by-the-book cop Hank Rafferty being dismissed from the force and serving a prison sentence for an apparent racial attack on police cadet Earl Montgomery. On his release, Hank is forced to take a job as a lowly security guard, where he is thrown together with an unexpected partner.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson. Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

programme.title: American Pie: The Wedding
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan. After pursuing each other through two movies, Jim and Michelle finally decide to tie the knot, but their friends' plans for a bachelor party almost derail the forthcoming nuptials.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: Bride Wars
programme.desc: Comedy with Anne Hathaway and Kate Hudson. Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

programme.title: American Reunion
programme.desc: Comedy that reunites the gang from the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan and Seann William Scott. Old friends Jim, Oz and Stifler assemble for their high school reunion, but while they might now be thirty-somethings with all the trappings of a suburban lifestyle, trouble, and rampant hormones, are still not far away.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Kevin Costner, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Alan Rickman and Morgan Freeman. After escaping from prison in the Holy Land, Robin of Locksley and his friend Azeem return to England, where they discover Robin's father murdered and King Richard exiled. When they meet a band of thieves in the woods, they join forces to try to oust the wicked Sheriff of Nottingham.

programme.title: Murder by Decree
programme.desc: Period detective drama starring Christopher Plummer and James Mason. When a brutal killer begins murdering London prostitutes, Scotland Yard takes the unusual approach of employing a psychic to help them with their investigations. But Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson are soon on the case.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival

programme.title: The Big Heat
programme.desc: Film noir starring Glenn Ford, Gloria Grahame and Lee Marvin. When tough detective Dave Bannion is assigned to investigate a colleague's suicide, he is sceptical about the reasons given for his death. Forced to work under cover, he discovers the existence of a suicide note that implicates a brutal Mob boss.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Futuristic adventure starring Kevin Costner and Dennis Hopper. The polar icecaps have melted causing the world to be flooded. The Mariner, a loner who has adapted to the new world, is rescued by Helen and Enola when he is caged on the Atoll, a floating settlement made out of scrap. However, the three survivors are pursued by the evil Smokers, as Enola may hold the key to finding the mythical Dryland.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Kevin Costner, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Alan Rickman and Morgan Freeman. After escaping from prison in the Holy Land, Robin of Locksley and his friend Azeem return to England, where they discover Robin's father murdered and King Richard exiled. When they meet a band of thieves in the woods, they join forces to try to oust the wicked Sheriff of Nottingham.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson and Kim Basinger. In the rotten heart of Gotham City, wrongdoers face a new nemesis: a caped crusader cracking down on crime. Photojournalist Vicki Vale's investigations take her to a party given by easy-going millionaire playboy Bruce Wayne. Meanwhile, dapper mobster Jack Napier becomes a fall guy for his criminal kingpin boss and undergoes a terrible transformation, emerging as a twisted villain destined to pose a deadly threat to Vicki and the mysterious Batman.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: Sequel to the 1989 action fantasy Batman, starring Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Michelle Pfeiffer. The Caped Crusader returns to action when Gotham City is threatened by corrupt tycoon Max Shreck and the vengeful Penguin. As he battles the forces of crime, Batman discovers a deadly new foe in the shape of feline vigilante, Catwoman.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Jim Carrey, Nicole Kidman and Chris O'Donnell. Former district attorney Harvey Two-Face holds Batman responsible for the attack that left half of his face disfigured, while brilliant scientist Edward Nygma bears a grudge against Batman's alter ego, Bruce Wayne, for rejecting one of his experiments. The pair decide to combine forces to exact their revenge.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the 1969 British caper movie, starring Mark Wahlberg and Edward Norton. A criminal gang run by Charlie Croker (Wahlberg) and veteran thief John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) pulls off an audacious gold bullion robbery in Venice, only for colleague Steve (Edward Norton) to run off with the loot, leaving Bridger dead. Finally tracking Steve down to LA, Croker enlists the help of Bridger's safecracking daughter Stella (Charlize Theron) to get even in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: Second World War action adventure directed by Quentin Tarantino and starring Brad Pitt. After a Jewish woman's family are slaughtered by the Nazis, she changes her identity and flees to Paris, only to come face to face with the man responsible for the massacre. Meanwhile, Lt Aldo Raine leads a guerrilla squad of Jewish Americans into occupied territory to carry out a series of raids on the enemy, earning a fearsome reputation in the process.
