programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Monster horror starring Matthew Broderick and Jean Reno. When a Japanese vessel is sunk in the South Pacific and enormous footprints are discovered in Panama, a team of scientists is brought in to investigate. But radiation expert Niko Tatopoulos has his own theory - nuclear bomb tests have mutated a lizard to gigantic proportions and Manhattan is now under threat.

programme.title: The Long Kiss Goodnight
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Geena Davis and Samuel L Jackson. A housewife with amnesia who hires a private detective to find out about her past life discovers that she was once a hitwoman for the CIA, and that someone wants her dead.

Historical action adventure starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey and David Wenham. When the fiercely ambitious King Xerxes of Persia plans to invade Greece, King Leonidas mobilises his personal bodyguard of 300 Spartan warriors to defend the pass at Thermopylae.

programme.title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson and Donnie Yen. After years in exile, agent Xander Cage is brought back into action when a potentially lethal space weapon falls into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Jim Carrey, Nicole Kidman and Chris O'Donnell. Former district attorney Harvey Two-Face holds Batman responsible for the attack that left half of his face disfigured, while brilliant scientist Edward Nygma bears a grudge against Batman's alter ego, Bruce Wayne, for rejecting one of his experiments. The pair decide to combine forces to exact their revenge.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Monster horror starring Matthew Broderick and Jean Reno. When a Japanese vessel is sunk in the South Pacific and enormous footprints are discovered in Panama, a team of scientists is brought in to investigate. But radiation expert Niko Tatopoulos has his own theory - nuclear bomb tests have mutated a lizard to gigantic proportions and Manhattan is now under threat.

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Tom Hiddleston, Brie Larson and Samuel L Jackson. A group of scientists and mercenaries are sent to a newly discovered Pacific island to investigate its unusual fauna. When their convoy is destroyed, the team faces a battle for survival against Skull Island's monstrous inhabitants - among them a certain giant ape.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: Second World War action adventure directed by Quentin Tarantino and starring Brad Pitt. After a Jewish woman's family are slaughtered by the Nazis, she changes her identity and flees to Paris, only to come face to face with the man responsible for the massacre. Meanwhile, Lt Aldo Raine leads a guerrilla squad of Jewish Americans into occupied territory to carry out a series of raids on the enemy, earning a fearsome reputation in the process.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Jason Statham and Paddy Considine. When a serial killer known as the "Blitz" begins to target policemen, it's left up to loose-cannon, no-nonsense cop Tom Brant to catch the villain. But as the killings continue, Brant's maverick methods of policing increasingly come into conflict with the by-the-book approach of his new boss, Nash.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: Suspense thriller starring Morgan Freeman. Following the abduction of a senator's daughter, psychological profiler Alex Cross is forced to join the hunt when he's contacted by the kidnapper. Working closely with the agent responsible for security at the girl's school, Cross uncovers a disturbing conspiracy.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a chilling turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening phone messages during their dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming suitor is behind the harassment. Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum

But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: The Golden Voyage of Sinbad

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts

As conflict erupts, museum researcher Elena and former soldier Noah are caught between the warring sides.

programme.title: Cocaine Bear

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Frances McDormand, Woody Harrelson and Sam Rockwell. Seven months after Mildred Hayes's daughter was found raped and murdered, no suspect has come to light. Drama, starring Dirk Bogarde, Michael Redgrave and Bonar Colleano

programme.desc: James is joined by fellow chef Tony Singh for a tour of the Isle of Skye and is inspired by the amazing local seafood to cook up a tasty dish using monkfish and mussels. programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: On Remembrance weekend, James cooks cured trout and popcorn prawns with ponzu tuna for Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen who talks about his work with the Royal British Legion as well as his career in design and TV. Chefs Richard Corrigan and Asma Khan join James in the kitchen

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Italy v South Africa (Kick-off 11.40am). Jill Douglas presents all the action from both teams' opening match of the Northern Hemsiphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium in Turin. World champions South Africa currently sit top of the Southern Hemisphere table with three wins from three, while Italy are bottom of the Northern table after three defeats, but will hope they can be competitive in front of their own fans. With analysis from John Barclay and Greig Laidlaw, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Tom Shanklin

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Scotland v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. Scotland impressed in the Southern Hemisphere Series, winning two of their three matches, but they face a tough test against the All Blacks, who have won all of their contests in the competition so far. With analysis from John Barclay, Greig Laidlaw and Sean Fitzpatrick, commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie, and reports from Gabriel Clarke

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Wales v Japan (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the match at Principality Stadium. Both teams won just one match of three in the Southern Hemisphere series and will be looking to impress this evening. The last time the nations met was in Wales' 2025 tour of Japan, when the teams won one match apiece. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: France v Fiji (Kick-off 8.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the match at Groupama Stadium in Lyon. This is the first game of the Northern Hemisphere series for both teams, and France narrowly lost to New Zealand in their first contest of the Southern Series, before recording victories over Australia and Japan. They will expect to continue their winning run against the Fijians, who have lost all three of their matches so far against Wales, England and Scotland. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Jamie Roberts, and commentary by Johnnie Hammond and Ben Kayser

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc:
It's the morning of the Moon Cake Day festival. Love Monster announces to everyone that he is going to make an enormous, record-breaking, strawberry moon cake for the finale, which will take place at his house later. The festival begins, and Love Monster borrows a recipe book from Book Cub on how to make moon cakes. Love Monster reads the list of ingredients; he'll need eggs, butter, flour and strawberries. Book Cub reminds him that big moon cakes take a little longer to make, but they are worth the extra work.
Love Monster is excited to start baking but is immediately distracted by Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny, who invites him to join in the rabbit lantern race. Love Monster decides to have one quick race, and then he'll start the moon cake. When Love Monster begins to head home, he is distracted by the sounds of Elder Panda playing a beautiful melody on a guzheng. He decides to stay for one little song but ends up staying longer to have a go himself. He plays a cool song and beatboxes along, but then he realises that the sun is setting, and he hasn't even begun making his moon cake.
He quickly starts to run back to his house but is distracted yet again - this time by Book Cub's shadow puppet show. Enthralled, Love Monster sits down and accidentally watches the whole show. It is now really late! Love Monster rushes to the shop to get the ingredients for the moon cake and hurries back home. But when he gets back, he realises that he has forgotten the strawberries! Just then, everyone arrives outside - they're ready for the moon cake.
Love Monster panics and starts throwing together the ingredients and adding in pickles and onions in place of the strawberries. But it's too late: there's not enough time to finish it and his cake is a disaster. He admits to his friends that he got distracted by all of the festival fun and didn't leave enough time to make the enormous moon cake he promised them all. Everyone is disappointed, but Elder Kitten says that mini cakes would be tasty too. Everyone has fun baking their own personalised moon cakes before gathering to eat them and watch the moonrise.

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: The second half of the comedy challenge series kicks off here, and it looks as if four of the contestants still have a good chance of lifting Taskmaster Greg Davies's golden head in the final - regular viewers will no doubt have guessed whose chances are looking rather more bleak. This week, Daisy May Cooper gets rather cross, Mawaan Rizwan learns a lesson about waterfowl and Richard Herring wrings out a wet sock

programme.title: The Wild
programme.desc: The son of a lion kept in a zoo in Central Park is crated up and shipped to Africa. His worried father musters a band of fellow creatures and escapes from captivity in a quest to rescue the youngster. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Kiefer Sutherland, James Belushi, Eddie Izzard, Janeane Garofalo and William Shatner

programme.title: Eternals
programme.desc: When monstrous entities called Deviants infest the Earth in 5000 BC Mesopotamia, an ancient race of beings known as Celestials, led by the mighty Arishem, fashion humanity's superpowered protectors, the Eternals. For more than 7,000 years, this band of near-immortal saviours live among us, in plain sight but unseen. They are instructed not to interfere in human conflicts unless Deviants are involved, and watch with dismay as humans resolve differences with bloodshed. Sci-fi adventure from Marvel Studios, starring Gemma Chan, Richard Madden, Angelina Jolie and Salma Hayek

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Daisy Ridley. Born in New York in 1905, Trudy Ederle survives childhood illness and goes on to defy societal norms by pursuing her passion for swimming. After achieving success in local competitions, she decides to take on her biggest challenge: swimming across the English Channel.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: Classic animated romantic fantasy from Disney, based on the popular children's story by Charles Perrault. The beautiful Cinderella endures a life of hardship with her malicious sisters and stepmother. But a visit from her fairy godmother could be set to change the downtrodden girl's fortunes.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: Animated science-fiction adventure based on Robert Louis Stevenson's classic novel, Treasure Island. When a pirate treasure map falls into the hands of young tearaway Jim Hawkins, he is determined to find the fabled loot. Joining a space galleon as a cabin boy, he sets off on an intergalactic voyage of discovery, under the watchful eye of mysterious cyborg cook John Silver.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure sequel starring Ben Barnes, Georgie Henley, William Moseley, Anna Popplewell and Skandar Keynes. Summoned back to Narnia by the beleaguered Prince Caspian, the Pevensie children join the struggle to deliver the magical kingdom from the dark forces of the tyrannical Lord Miraz.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: Animated fairy tale from Pixar, featuring the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly. Merida, a tomboy Scottish princess, flees the court after her parents insist she should settle down and get married. However, when the errant teenager encounters a witch in the woods and asks her to cast a spell to change the situation, it sets off a chaotic chain of events that only Merida's bravery and archery skills can reverse.

programme.title: Tarzan
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Tony Goldwyn and Minnie Driver. Tarzan has lived a contented life in the jungle with his ape "family" since he was a small child, but it's only when he befriends Jane Porter that he discovers that he is human - a realisation that presents him with a difficult decision.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: Animated fantasy featuring the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos, and songs by Randy Newman. In jazz-age New Orleans, a waitress and a playboy prince seek the help of some quirky creatures as they try to break a witch doctor's spell that has turned them into frogs.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans. The bookish daughter of a clockmaker embarks on a dangerous quest when her father becomes lost in the woods, and discovers a Gothic castle that is home to a fearsome beast and his magically cursed servants. Can Belle learn to love the beast and break the spell?

programme.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.desc: Animated musical drama featuring the voices of Chris Sarandon and Catherine O'Hara. Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King, longs to escape the routine of Halloweentown. Through a door in a tree, he stumbles upon Christmastown where he engineers the kidnapping of Santa Claus and wreaks havoc among the inhabitants.

programme.title: The Proposal
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Sandra Bullock and Ryan Reynolds. Uptight Manhattan book editor Margaret Tate treats her assistant Andrew like dirt. So when she's threatened with deportation to her native Canada because of an expired visa, she pressurises him into marrying her. But just as the authorities question the validity of their relationship, Margaret is invited to spend a weekend with Andrew's family.

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy drama from the director of The Royal Tenenbaums and Moonrise Kingdom, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson and Cate Blanchett. After his best friend is eaten by a mysterious jaguar shark, famous oceanographer Steve Zissou vows revenge. Joining his crew on the mission are a pregnant journalist and a pilot who claims to be Zissou's long-lost son.

programme.title: Tomorrowland: A World Beyond
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring George Clooney, Hugh Laurie and Britt Robertson. When teenage whizzkid Casey Newton obtains a mysterious pin that gives her visions of a futuristic utopia, her life is suddenly plunged into danger. The only person who can help Casey to survive, find Tomorrowland and save the world is former boy inventor Frank Walker. But he's now a bitter, grizzled recluse who just wants to be left alone.

programme.desc: Jay and Claire shoot an advert to rival a competitor's catchy new campaign - but creative differences threaten to tear the father and daughter apart. Phil, Luke and Manny join forces to take down a Peeping Tom who has been using a drone to spy on a sunbathing Gloria, Cam worries about Lily's lack of singing skills ahead of a talent show, and Haley has a confession for Andy when he's rushed to hospital with appendicitis

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay switches sides after joining Cam's bowling team, while Phil and Claire see a different side to their neighbours. American comedy following the lives of three dysfunctional households - a man who struggles to keep up with his younger wife, an embarrassing husband and a gay couple getting used to parenthood after adopting a Vietnamese baby. Starring Ed O'Neill and Julie Bowen

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge encourages Bart to explore his creative side and signs him up for piano lessons, but the youngster is less than enthusiastic about the prospect until he meets his Russian teacher Zhenya. Meanwhile, Homer is distraught after losing his last two hairs and becoming completely bald. Guest starring the voices of Jane Krakowski, Bill Hader and Justin Bieber

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer, Moe and Lenny go in pursuit of Carl when he skips town with $200,000 in winnings from a lottery ticket he bought with them. However, their search makes them realise how little they know about their friend and almost reaches a dead-end until Lisa points them in the direction of Iceland. Featuring music by Sigur Ros

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge is feeling neglected by Homer, and the timing couldn't be worse as their 10th wedding anniversary is fast approaching. Little does she know her husband is planning a grand romantic gesture inspired by a special moment from their first year of marriage. But wires get crossed when the miffed housewife stumbles upon a dodgy website for couples bored of their partners, and she ends up chatting to the too-good-to-be-true Ben (voiced by Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer, Marge and the kids mend their ways in a bid to convince a vigilant social worker they are normal, well-adjusted members of society - but their plans are thrown into disarray by the arrival of the showgirl Homer married bigamously in Las Vegas. Featuring the guest voices of Delroy Lindo (The Good Fight) and Jane Kaczmarek (Malcolm in the Middle)

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Frankie's determination to help Caleb causes accusations to fly in the Keane household. Abigail pushes Dee Dee to audition for the lead role in the school play. And a resident has an intense job interview

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Mr Johnson, now elected to the State Senate, is one of the speakers at Abbott's careers day. But are things a bit weird between Janine and Gregory?

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will's grandmother pays a visit, leaving domestic disharmony in her wake. American comedy, starring Will Smith, James Avery and Virginia Capers

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will goes on a date with Jazz's sister Janet, until it becomes clear that she is not only beautiful but also very bossy. To Will's dismay, Janet changes her tune when cousin Carlton appears. Comedy, starring Will Smith, with an appearance by Vivica A Fox

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on Gordon, Gino & Fred: Viva España, EastEnders, Top Guns: Inside the RAF, Beat the Chasers, Say Yes to the Dress with Tan France, The Yorkshire Vet, My Floating Home and ITV News coverage of the school concrete crisis. From September 2023

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on programmes including My Mum, Your Dad, Welcome to Wrexham, Love & Death, Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden, Animals Up Close with Bertie Gregory, Puzzling with Lucy Worsley and This Morning. From September 2023

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Sasha Luss, Luke Evans and Helen Mirren. A young Russian woman fleeing her abusive home is recruited to the KGB and trained as an assassin. Initially, Anna is told she will be employed for only five years and then allowed a comfy retirement, but she soon discovers her handlers have other plans and a deadly game of survival begins.

programme.title: The Future
programme.desc: Drama starring Miranda July and Hamish Linklater. An eccentric childless LA couple in their 30s decide to give a home to a stray cat, a decision which spurs each into a flurry of "live a little" activity before the arrival of the pet changes their lives for ever.

programme.title: They Rode West
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Francis and Donna Reed. The new medical officer at a remote fort comes in for criticism when he provides treatment to the local native American tribe.

programme.title: The Nevadan
programme.desc: In order to locate a vast stash of stolen gold, a US Marshal orchestrates the escape of a stagecoach robber, but ends up getting caught in his dealings with a greedy rancher. Western, starring Randolph Scott, Dorothy Malone and Forrest Tucker

programme.title: Send Me No Flowers
programme.desc: A hypochondriac who mistakenly believes he has only a few weeks to live decides not to tell his wife - and also sets about finding her a suitable second husband to succeed him. Romantic comedy, teaming Rock Hudson and Doris Day with Tony Randall, Paul Lynde and Edward Andrews

programme.title: The Golden Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Phillip Law, Caroline Munro and Tom Baker. Sinbad acquires part of a magical golden amulet but when he sets sail to find the remainder, he comes up against the evil forces of the magician Koura.

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Anthony Ramos and Dominique Fishback. New York, 1994: when planet-devouring entity Unicron and its Terrorcon minions turn their attention to Earth, Optimus Prime and his fellow Autobots must combine forces with the beast-like Maximals to repel the threat. As conflict erupts, museum researcher Elena and former soldier Noah are caught between the warring sides.

programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Keri Russell. A black bear stumbles across an abandoned stash of cocaine in a Tennessee forest. When it eats some of the drug, the bear is sent on a violent rampage, endangering various hikers, rangers and drug dealers, as well as nurse Sari - whose daughter has skipped school to spend a day in the woods.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
A former butcher brings his defunct sausage-making machine to the barn for Dominic Chinea, the resident metal work expert. It was once an essential bit of kit in owner Marcus Harding's dad's butcher's shop. A teenage Marcus was regularly tasked with sausage filling and became a dab hand. However when the shop closed, the machine was banished to the shed, where dust and rust has brought it to a grinding halt. This is a first for Dom and he's eager to roll up his sleeves and give the vintage machine a total overhaul. The rusted internal parts are too delicate for sandblasting so Dom comes up with a scientific solution, using an electrolysis machine. Once reassembled and given a new lick of paint this contraption is put to the test, when Marcus shares his family recipe and it's bangers for the Repair Shop team lunch!
Mary Murphy from Stafford arrives with a unique and fragile historical archive. It is in desperate need of expert intervention by bookbinder Chris Shaw. This crumbling Edwardian album is full of treasured family postcards sent by Mary's grandma to her sisters. Each precious card documents the young woman's day-to-day life and adventures and is treasured by Mary's family. Chris works meticulously by hand to display each of the cards in windowed pages and incorporates the original album covers with a sturdy new spine. Mary and her sister are over the moon with the results.
And silversmith Brenton West transforms a cherished family heirloom that was a wedding gift over half a century ago. The hot water urn, known as a samovar, was one of the few belongings that accompanied Nawzad and Karen when they fled Iraq with their young family. Brenton transforms the dented, tarnished urn and gets it back in action.

Nick and the team have amassed a huge group of volunteers for Arlo and the family, as they set to work creating a safe and inspiring space that Arlo and his family can call home

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: This time, Nick Knowles and the team transforms a home in Bromsgrove. Karis, a 28-year-old woman who has cerebral palsy, currently lives with her mother, Karen, but now her own health is deteriorating and it is making caring for Karis almost impossible. The family have decided that Karis should move in with her older sister Jo, but her entire home is inaccessible for Karis, so the team decides to build a large two-storey extension to make the house more suitable. Elsewhere, Billy takes on jousting at Warwick Castle

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: The team transforms a home in Bolton, Greater Manchester for the Taylor-Mann family, making the house more suitable for nine-year-old William, who has severe autism. Williams's condition means that he is extremely hypersensitive to noise, and being in close proximity to his siblings is often just too much for him to bear. Nick Knowles and the team, with the help of kind volunteers, transform the property to create a quiet, calm space that can help William feel as comfortable as possible

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance: Coast and Country
programme.desc: Paramedics in Oxford treat a woman suffering from a mystery illness, while in Portsmouth, the crews treat an elderly diabetic patient with dangerously low blood sugar.

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance: Coast and Country
programme.desc: The crews attend a man who has fallen off his bike and a 4-year-old struggling with tonsillitis. Plus, a 35-year-old man with chest pains proves very hard to find.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: The documentary follows the team in control and crews out on the road in Wigan and Bolton. Advanced paramedic John is dispatched to an unconscious patient who isn't breathing after a fire in a high-rise flat, while another call comes in about a man who has been burnt in an industrial accident in a food factory

programme.title: Death Row: Countdown to Execution
programme.desc: Susanna Reid travels to Texas to meet convicted killer Billie Wayne Coble in the days leading up to his scheduled execution. In 1989 he pleaded guilty to triple murder and has been on death row ever since. Now 70, he is fighting for a last-minute stay of execution. If it fails, he will be the oldest man put to death in Texas for more than 100 years. Susannah asks Billie to relive the night of the crime and tries to find out how it has affected him and also speaks to his relatives and others involved in the case

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: The team struggles to explain how a DAF 33 gearbox works, and office manager Sarah attempts to bring order to the auto memorabilia sale.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Derek gives the once-over to a Royale Formula Ford race car, and Paul is on a marathon trip to pick up a 1953 MGYB, a Moggy Van, and an '80s Yamaha 250RD motorbike.

programme.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programme.desc: The boys visit Swindon and Chippenham. Henry finds and restores a much maligned BSA Ariel 3 moped and Simon gives a Ford Transit gearbox a new lease of life.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is at Elgin's port, the coastal town of Lossiemouth, where the Labour Party's first prime minister James Ramsay MacDonald was born. Nearby, Michael finds a remote boarding school established in the 1930s and famous today both for its unusual ideas and its royal former pupils. His penultimate stop is Inverness, where he uncovers the work of female photographer MEM Donaldson, who documented a Highland way of life that was rapidly disappearing. Michael's journey ends at Loch Ness, where he joins a Deep Scan research team scouring the deep for signs of the elusive monster

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo arrives in Hassocks and makes his way to the beautiful Sussex village of Ditchling, where a Roman Catholic community of artists once made their home. Next, he visits the seaside town of Bexhill-on-Sea, before the Kent and East Sussex heritage railway conveys Michael from Bodiam Castle through the scenic Rother Valley to Tenterden, and finally arrives in the village of Benenden

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the West Country between the wars, setting off from the Cornish seaside resort of St Ives and ending his first in the former mining village of St Day. He visits Britain's first studio pottery, where he attempts a decorative wax technique and feels the heat of the firing kiln. Michael also joins a family on holiday in a railway carriage called Harvey

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo follows his 1930s Bradshaw's guide to the unspoilt East Sussex port of Rye, where he learns about the loss of a generation of lifeboatmen in 1928. On the beaches at Rye, Michael explores one of 28,000 pillboxes constructed around the British coastline during the Second World War, before boarding the Romney, Hythe and Dymchurch railway to Dungeness

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo arrives at a milestone on his American journey as he reaches the boundary between the northern and southern states, known as the Mason-Dixon line. Beginning in Wilmington, North Carolina, he uncovers the history of gunpowder production in Delaware, before heading to Baltimore, where he discovers how the first American steam engine owed a lot to British technology. On the city's east coast, Michael visits the star-shaped Fort McHenry, and learns how the Star-Spangled Banner national anthem was born

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Derek travels to the Lancashire coast to pick up a rare 1972 Citroen SM, and Dave admires a two-decade-old Punto with just 42 miles on the clock.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
programme.desc: The team buy one of Derek's favourite Austin commercials and convert it to electric, and also snap up a super-rare 50's American beach bike.

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: Laurence Olivier narrates this documentary chronicling events leading up to the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbour on December 7, 1941, and the subsequent collapse of unprepared British forces before the advancing enemy in Singapore. Includes interviews with veterans from both sides

programme.title: War Factories
programme.desc: Japan would create arguably the greatest fighter in WW2 - the Mitsubishi Zero. But their failed War Factories would ultimately reduce the Zero to a Kamikaze plane.

programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Stringed instrument restorer Julyan Wallis sets to work on a beloved banjo. The banjo belonged to Kipper Tranter's dear departed friend, Ted. Many years ago, Ted took a young and wayward Kipper under his wing, for which Kipper is eternally grateful. The friends shared a love of bluegrass music and would regularly play together. When Ted passed away, he wanted his beloved banjo to go to Kipper. The 80-year-old instrument is not in great shape and Kipper would love it repaired, so that it can be passed onto another generation of musical talent.
The workshop's next arrival is Julia Emmett from Berkshire, with a pair of vintage rollerskates for leather gal Suzie Fletcher. The 1930s skates belonged to her father, who was quite something back in the day, whizzing around on this set of wheels. They are a treasured memento for Julia but the leather is parched and cracked and the wooden wheels are riddled with holes, courtesy of some hungry woodworm.
And antique restorer Will Kirk's expertise is called upon when David Worssom arrives with a very old and elaborate wooden salad bowl. This unusual item was presented to David's grandfather in the late 1800s during his service in the Boer War. The bowl was then inherited by his father and was a familiar fixture in David's family home. It conjures vivid memories of his father and his childhood. The various segments of the bowl are falling apart, the only thing holding it together is some ornate silver fretwork. Brenton West tends to the silver while Will reassembles the puzzle.

programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and Ricardo Montalban. In the 23rd century, Admiral James T Kirk is a guest aboard the Enterprise, which is taking part in a training exercise. But the routine voyage becomes a serious mission when his old ship is lured into a deadly trap, placing Kirk and his companions at the mercy of a crazed adversary, the formidable Khan.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring William Shatner and DeForest Kelley. Barely surviving the wrath of Khan, the battle-scarred starship Enterprise limps back to Earth, saved only by the sacrifice of the late Captain Spock. However, the Vulcan's spirit is still with the crew, and back on the artificial Eden of the new Genesis planet his corpse is missing. Against orders, Admiral Kirk decides to lead the search for Spock and bring him home.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. In the 23rd century, Captain Kirk and his intrepid band of space travellers discover a probe in the vicinity of Earth that is trying to contact a humpback whale, a species that is extinct. In order to prevent the probe destroying the planet, Kirk and his crew visit 1986 San Francisco in order to locate two whales to take back to the future.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Jim Carrey, Nicole Kidman and Chris O'Donnell. Former district attorney Harvey Two-Face holds Batman responsible for the attack that left half of his face disfigured, while brilliant scientist Edward Nygma bears a grudge against Batman's alter ego, Bruce Wayne, for rejecting one of his experiments. The pair decide to combine forces to exact their revenge.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as drifter and ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who falls foul of the redneck sheriff of Hope, Oregon. Arrested and beaten, Rambo escapes and takes refuge in the local woods, ready to defend himself with deadly skills learnt during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Forbidden Fruits
programme.desc: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch coven with co-workers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin challenges their sisterhood, forcing the trio to confront their inner darkness. As tensions rise and the coven's secrets threaten to spill, they must face their fears or all meet a violent end. Comedy horror, starring Lili Reinhart

programme.title: Finnegan's Foursome
programme.desc: Two rival brothers and their adult children travel to Ireland to scatter their father's ashes, turning clashing egos and comic mishaps into an unexpected week of family bonding. Comedy drama written, directed by and starring Edward Burns, with Brian d'Arcy James and Erica Hernandez

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: Racewalkers
programme.desc: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural talent for the sport as they challenge the sport's top competitor. Comedy, directed by and starring Kevin Claydon and Phil Moniz

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Midwinter Break
programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

programme.title: Splitsville
programme.desc: When Ashley asks husband Carey for a divorce, he turns to friends Julie and Paul for support. Carey is stunned to discover their secret to happiness is an open marriage. However, when Carey and Julie cross a line, the arrangement unleashes jealousy and chaos, forcing both couples to confront what they want from love and commitment. Romantic comedy, starring Dakota Johnson, Adria Arjona, and Michael Angelo Covino, who also co-wrote and directed

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Couples Weekend
programme.desc: Four adults navigate deception and desire when a fallen tree on New Year's Eve triggers a chain of events that challenges their relationships and the lies they tell themselves and each other. Writer/director Nora Kirkpatrick's comedy drama, starring Alexandra Daddario and Daveed Diggs

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. Darlene plays matchmaker, bringing the reporter together with her grandson Matt, a firefighter, over the festive season. Romantic drama, starring Lyndsy Fonseca

programme.title: Reminders of Him
programme.desc: Kenna Rowan emerges from a seven-year prison sentence, and returns to the hometown where she was held legally responsible for the death of her boyfriend, Scotty Landry. She is grimly resolved to confront ghosts of the past so she can finally meet the daughter she was forced to give up. Drama, starring Maika Monroe

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: Comedy starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. With the children now able to walk and talk, the Ubriacco family acquire a mongrel puppy, Rocks. As the Christmas season approaches the family's usual struggles are complicated by the unexpected gift of Daphne, a pampered poodle.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jackie Chan, Dave Franco and Justin Theroux as the Lego figures. Teenager Lloyd is secretly part of a team of heroes who protect their city from the evil Lord Garmadon - who happens to be Lloyd's father.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Misguided inventor Flint Lockwood creates a machine that can turn water into food. But what initially seems like the answer to his community's economic crisis soon begins to cause some unexpected problems.

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy with the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Flint Lockwood's mutating machine is no longer turning water into food but producing food/animal hybrids, or foodimals, which very quickly overrun his home town.

programme.title: A Good Year
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, Chris Rock and David Schwimmer. A zebra called Marty tries to escape his comfortable existence at the Central Park Zoo and return to the wild. Accompanying him, albeit reluctantly, are Alex the lion, a neurotic giraffe and a no-nonsense hippo.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Ben Stiller, David Schwimmer and Chris Rock. The escaped animals from Central Park Zoo - Alex the Lion, Melman the Giraffe, Marty the Zebra and Gloria the Hippo - try to fly back from Madagascar but are forced down in the wilds of Africa, where they soon encounter some familiar faces.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: Horror comedy based on the popular books by R L Stine, starring Jack Black. When 15-year-old Zach breaks into his neighbour's house to investigate strange noises, he discovers that he lives next door to the author of the Goosebumps series, whose monstrous creations have to be kept in locked manuscripts. But when the monsters get loose, it's up to Zach to help imprison them again.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: Two youngsters unwittingly unleash all manner of monsters from a locked manuscript they find in an abandoned house. Comedy sequel, starring Madison Iseman, Jeremy Ray Taylor and Wendy McLendon-Covey

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Musical based on the Broadway hit, starring Quvenzhané Wallis, Cameron Diaz and Jamie Foxx. A foster child's life changes after accidentally meeting a workaholic tycoon running for mayor of New York.

programme.title: King Ivory
programme.desc: Tulsa narcotics cop Layne West is locked in a battle with the city's criminal underworld. When his son becomes addicted to fentanyl, West teams up with his partner Ty and FBI agent Beatty to bring down those responsible. Thriller, starring James Badge Dale and Ben Foster

programme.title: One Last Deal
programme.desc: A veteran sports agent scrambles to land one last high-stakes deal for his star client, with both their futures on the line. Drama, starring Danny Dyer and Elliott Rogers

programme.title: Mulholland Drive
programme.desc: Psychological thriller directed by David Lynch, starring Naomi Watts, Laura Elena Harring and Justin Theroux. An aspiring actress lands in Hollywood and is quickly drawn into the mystery of an amnesiac woman who has arrived at her lodgings. Meanwhile, a director battles sinister forces to try to complete his latest film.

programme.title: Lurker
programme.desc: A retail employee infiltrates the inner circle of an artist on the verge of stardom. As he gets closer to the budding music star, access and proximity become a matter of life and death. Writer/director Alex Russell's crime drama, starring Théodore Pellerin, Archie Madekwe and Sunny Suljic

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Action drama starring Kirsten Dunst, Wagner Moura and Cailee Spaeny. The USA is ravaged by civil war. Documenting the atrocities, a group of journalists - including veteran photographer Lee, reporter Joel and rookie Jessie - travel from New York to Washington DC to interview the President before armed secessionist militias reach the capital.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: Mulholland Drive
programme.desc: Psychological thriller directed by David Lynch, starring Naomi Watts, Laura Elena Harring and Justin Theroux. An aspiring actress lands in Hollywood and is quickly drawn into the mystery of an amnesiac woman who has arrived at her lodgings. Meanwhile, a director battles sinister forces to try to complete his latest film.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: National Security
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Martin Lawrence and Steve Zahn. A string of misunderstandings lead to by-the-book cop Hank Rafferty being dismissed from the force and serving a prison sentence for an apparent racial attack on police cadet Earl Montgomery. On his release, Hank is forced to take a job as a lowly security guard, where he is thrown together with an unexpected partner.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson. Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Spy spoof starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong. Nearly 30 years after they were adopted by different families, brothers Norman "Nobby" Butcher and Sebastian meet again. But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: Historical satire starring Steve Buscemi and Simon Russell Beale. In the immediate aftermath of Joseph Stalin's death in 1953, his cabinet jockey for position in the hope of becoming the next Soviet leader. As they argue over everything from funeral arrangements to the fate of the dictator's offspring, the divided government struggles to maintain order.

programme.title: Mr Deeds
programme.desc: Remake of Frank Capra's comedy Mr Deeds Goes to Town, starring Adam Sandler and Winona Ryder. Longfellow Deeds lives an uncomplicated life as a pizza-shop owner and aspiring greetings-card writer in a tiny town. But his world is thrown into disarray when he inherits a fortune from an unknown uncle.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: American Reunion
programme.desc: Comedy that reunites the gang from the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan and Seann William Scott. Old friends Jim, Oz and Stifler assemble for their high school reunion, but while they might now be thirty-somethings with all the trappings of a suburban lifestyle, trouble, and rampant hormones, are still not far away.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: Risqué teen comedy starring Tom Cruise and Rebecca De Mornay. Left to safeguard the family home while his parents are away, promising student Joel Goodson seizes the chance to have the time of his life. But when a friend's prank results in Joel being visited by troubled prostitute Lana, things get out of hand.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring David Duchovny and Julianne Moore. When scientists Ira Kane and Harry Block find a crashed meteorite in the Arizona desert, they are able to extract a slimy blue fluid from it. But the bizarre substance contains alien organisms that are capable of evolving at an unprecedented rate, and this has consequences for the survival of Earth itself.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Horror remake starring Jane Levy, Shiloh Fernandez and Lou Taylor Pucci. Four friends decamp to an isolated cabin in the woods to help drug addict Mia kick her habit. However, when one of them quotes from an ancient book of the dead, the forces of hell are unleashed and no one is safe.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Dee Wallace Stone and M Emmet Walsh. After escaping from their space prison, eight small carnivorous aliens called Krites land on Earth pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. A sleepy Kansas community is soon the scene for violent murder, as the Krites discover a new and very tasty addition to their menu.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: Sci-fi action comedy starring David Duchovny and Julianne Moore. When scientists Ira Kane and Harry Block find a crashed meteorite in the Arizona desert, they are able to extract a slimy blue fluid from it. But the bizarre substance contains alien organisms that are capable of evolving at an unprecedented rate, and this has consequences for the survival of Earth itself.

programme.title: Brightburn
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Elizabeth Banks, David Denman and Jackson A Dunn. A Kansas couple discovers a humanoid alien child inside a crashed spaceship and adopt him. Years later, the boy reaches adolescence - and starts to develop powers that pose a major threat to his community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Futuristic adventure starring Kevin Costner and Dennis Hopper. The polar icecaps have melted causing the world to be flooded. The Mariner, a loner who has adapted to the new world, is rescued by Helen and Enola when he is caged on the Atoll, a floating settlement made out of scrap. However, the three survivors are pursued by the evil Smokers, as Enola may hold the key to finding the mythical Dryland.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Chris Pine and Zachary Quinto. Rebellious youth James Kirk is persuaded to join the Starfleet Academy, where he befriends Dr Leonard "Bones" McCoy and clashes with officer Spock. When an evil Romulan arrives from the future, the young crew of the USS Enterprise find themselves in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: Second World War action adventure directed by Quentin Tarantino and starring Brad Pitt. After a Jewish woman's family are slaughtered by the Nazis, she changes her identity and flees to Paris, only to come face to face with the man responsible for the massacre. Meanwhile, Lt Aldo Raine leads a guerrilla squad of Jewish Americans into occupied territory to carry out a series of raids on the enemy, earning a fearsome reputation in the process.

programme.title: The Long Kiss Goodnight
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Geena Davis and Samuel L Jackson. A housewife with amnesia who hires a private detective to find out about her past life discovers that she was once a hitwoman for the CIA, and that someone wants her dead.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Thriller starring Jason Statham. A troubled former soldier on the run from a court martial assumes another man's identity and goes into hiding on the streets of London. But the desire to avenge injustice is something he can never leave behind.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Jet Li. A highly skilled group of mercenaries are commissioned by a shady operative to assassinate the murderous dictator of a South American island. But they should know that an operation like this is never straightforward.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Bruce Willis. The crack team of mercenaries take on what looks like the easy job of retrieving an item from a crashed plane in Albania. But when one of the group is murdered by an international arms dealer, it turns into a mission of revenge.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone. Mercenary Barney Ross decides to retire his ageing band of cohorts and replace them with younger models for a mission to capture a ruthless adversary from his past. But when things get sticky, help comes from an unlikely direction.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Dwayne Johnson, Vin Diesel and Paul Walker. Fugitive Dominic Toretto assembles his old team to steal $100 million from Brazil's most corrupt businessman so that they can disappear for ever. But with tenacious FBI agent Luke Hobbs on their trail, their plan just got a lot more complicated.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker and Dwayne Johnson. Following a heist in Rio, Dominic Toretto's gang has dispersed to different places around the world. They start with a walk, where they count all the poppies that have been put around their village - how many will there be? Later, they visit a camp where they learn what it was like to live in the UK during World War II. An air raid siren goes off, and they practice running into an old Anderson shelter!
The family then visits an air museum, where Alicia is shown lots of amazing aircraft from the war. Alicia finds out what it was like to fly them when she meets a 99-year-old World War II pilot John. They go flying together and have a fantastic time! John then shows her his medals and tells her his amazing stories of being a pilot in the war.
Before heading home, Alicia and her family pay their respects to those who have served in the line of duty by laying a wreath at the Armed Forces Memorial in the National Memorial Arboretum. They remember everyone who has served to protect us whilst a bugler plays The Last Post.

programme.desc:

programme.desc: Petit and his friends are having a lot of fun pretending to be robots, until one of them presses a button and Petit gets the hiccups. Why can't he stop hiccupping? Greg can't stop sneezing, Laura yawns and Roman coughs. Could it be that everyone is turning into real-life robots?

programme.desc: The sheephead fish, which is very sneaky - it can eat pretty much anything as it has very sharp teeth and can steal the bait off fishing hooks without getting caught

programme.desc: Morag Ann MacNeil reads A' Choinean Chòir by Katie Cotton, illustrated by Blanca Gomez and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart

programme.title: Bethany - An Dannsair Gàidhealach (Bethany - The Highland Dancer)
programme.desc: Born into a family of Highland dancers, 11-year-old Bethany is determined to follow in the footsteps of her mum and aunties. Highland dancing is more than just an artform and requires strength and determination. The sword dance, an ancient dance of war, was once danced by warriors before battle and was considered a good omen if the dance was completed without touching the swords. Bethany sets herself a daunting challenge - performing the notoriously difficult dance, at a major Highland dancing competition in Stornoway

programme.title: Belle agus Sebastian

programme.desc: Choirstaidh takes a look at the famous artist Hilma Af Klint, and shows you how to make your own picture in her style

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc: Bitzer gets his wish for some peace and quiet when Shaun becomes hypnotised by Mowermouth the goat and finally stops bothering him. However, with the whole flock under the influence of Mowermouth's powerful gaze, Bitzer soon realises just how much he needs his old friend

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: A Great Dane called Greta visits Flix's school as a part of official Dog/Cat Summit Relations. Flix positions himself as Greta's chaperone for the week

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: The lads contemplate winter and come up with heart-warming comfort foods. Ruairidh cooks red cabbage and a lamb hotpot with mint sauce, and Uisdean prepares a mutton chump roast

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin a' chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba 's e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people's skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon walks along the south end of Kerrera with Kim Carnie, a few miles away from where she was raised in Oban. As they walk along picturesque bays with panoramic views of Oban Bay and the Slate Islands, Kim discusses the importance of Gaelic in her life and how that has shaped her life and career as a singer. She opens up about love and identity and how that has evolved over the years while enjoying the surrounding nature and fresh autumn air

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon goes on a journey to find out about the deep divide between wealth and poverty in São Paulo, Brazil. From the affluent gated communities to the overcrowded favelas, invisible walls separate people in this city. programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.desc: On the final night in Edinburgh, business owner and socialite Maz is determined that a fantastic fondue, a slap-up portion of posh fish and chips and a handsome Highland piper will be enough to see her become the belle of the ball, capturing the £1,000 prize

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Stringed instrument restorer Julyan Wallis sets to work on a beloved banjo. The banjo belonged to Kipper Tranter's dear departed friend, Ted. Many years ago, Ted took a young and wayward Kipper under his wing, for which Kipper is eternally grateful. The friends shared a love of bluegrass music and would regularly play together. When Ted passed away, he wanted his beloved banjo to go to Kipper. The 80-year-old instrument is not in great shape and Kipper would love it repaired, so that it can be passed onto another generation of musical talent.
The workshop's next arrival is Julia Emmett from Berkshire, with a pair of vintage rollerskates for leather gal Suzie Fletcher. The 1930s skates belonged to her father, who was quite something back in the day, whizzing around on this set of wheels. They are a treasured memento for Julia but the leather is parched and cracked and the wooden wheels are riddled with holes, courtesy of some hungry woodworm.
And antique restorer Will Kirk's expertise is called upon when David Worssom arrives with a very old and elaborate wooden salad bowl. This unusual item was presented to David's grandfather in the late 1800s during his service in the Boer War. The bowl was then inherited by his father and was a familiar fixture in David's family home. It conjures vivid memories of his father and his childhood. The various segments of the bowl are falling apart, the only thing holding it together is some ornate silver fretwork. Brenton West tends to the silver while Will reassembles the puzzle.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: The chef visits the home of New Nordic cuisine - Copenhagen - where he goes foraging for rosehip and learns about the art of pickling buds, bark and flowers. He's cheered to find plenty of traditional favourites, such as the city's famous Smorrebrod open sandwiches on rye bread, delicious poached turbot with cabbage and lemon butter sauce and - of course - the ubiquitous Danish pastry. Back at home, Rick cooks fried pork belly with lovage potatoes and parsley sauce, which has been voted Denmark's favourite dish

programme.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
programme.desc: The chef heads to Cadiz in Spain, where he samples two of the city's most revered culinary stars - fresh tuna and Manzanilla sherry. Rick is captivated by the narrow winding streets as he walks in the footsteps of the ancient Phoenician and Arab traders, whose influence on the city can still be seen to this day. Back home, he prepares flamenco eggs and arroz verde, or green rice, made with garlic, parsley, clams and prawns, producing the vibrant colours of the Spanish flag

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers explore the history of the Vegetarian Society and discover how the movement changed public attitudes and became part of the mainstream. They also consider how British gardening has influenced the nation's cuisine, and provide a few recipes along the way

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales go in search of the lost route between London and the sea, which has not been fully open for more than 200 years and requires four different boats to traverse now. They leave the Thames at Teddington and travel through the Surrey and Sussex countryside before arriving at Guildford, and a canal-side theatre where they have both regularly performed. The final leg of the trip brings them to the River Arun before reaching the English Channel

programme.title: Top Gear
